比起其他人給我的壓力，我更多的是為了分析角色、決定自己應該如何表演，而感到焦慮和煩惱。可是，拍攝《勝利號》的時候，我開始感受到來自外界的壓力。說真的，那種壓力非常大。我甚至會想：『為什麼會選我來演這個角色呢？』而且，因為電影是透過 Netflix 上映的，所以我們到現在還不知道，究竟有多少觀眾看過這部作品。但我真的感受到了很沉重的負擔。
a.en: I really didn't feel any burden. And that's how I felt when I was filming 'The Handmaiden' or even after the filming was over. I was very much aware of the fact that I wouldn't do everything so well and how I would need to have the help of many others for my next work. So nothing felt too burdensome when I did 'Little Forest' and '1987.' I was much more stressed analyzing the characters and setting my own direction of how to act rather than feeling any pressure from others. But when I was doing this movie, I felt a burden from the outside. Honestly, I felt a lot of pressure. I even wondered why I was cast for the role. Since this was released through Netflix, we still don't know how many audience members the movie garnered, but I really felt a big burden.
a.o: I really didn't feel any burden. And that's how I felt when I was filming 'The Handmaiden' or even after the filming was over. I was very much aware of the fact that I wouldn't do everything so well and how I would need to have the help of many others for my next work. So nothing felt too burdensome when I did 'Little Forest' and '1987.' I was much more stressed analyzing the characters and setting my own direction of how to act rather than feeling any pressure from others. But when I was doing this movie, I felt a burden from the outside. Honestly, I felt a lot of pressure. I even wondered why I was cast for the role. Since this was released through Netflix, we still don't know how many audience members the movie garnered, but I really felt a big burden.

q.zh: 現在，妳還是會有那樣的感覺嗎？
q.en: Do you still feel that way?
q.o: Do you still feel that way?

a.zh: 我覺得，自己正在慢慢學習如何放下。因為一直想著那些事情，其實也不會讓情況有什麼改變。所以到最後，我就會告訴自己：『我已經盡了最大的努力。』比起那些壓力，我過去一直在做的事情，以及認真分析每個場景和角色，才是更加重要的。
a.en: I think I am learning to let go. Thinking about this is not getting me anywhere, so I end up just coming to the conclusion that I have done my best. Things that I have done before and analyzing the scenes and characters is what is more important.
a.o: I think I am learning to let go. Thinking about this is not getting me anywhere, so I end up just coming to the conclusion that I have done my best. Things that I have done before and analyzing the scenes and characters is what is more important.

q.zh: 妳認為，自己身上最有魅力的地方是什麼？
q.en: What makes you charming in your opinion?
q.o: What makes you charming in your opinion?

a.zh: 可能是因為我讓人覺得相處起來很自在？也可能是因為我很坦率？或者是因為，我不太會刻意包裝自己吧？（笑）哎呀，太害羞了，我不說了。
a.en: Maybe because I am comfortable, maybe because I am honest, or maybe because I don't embellish myself too much? (Laughs) I am embarrassed so I won't say more.
a.o: Maybe because I am comfortable, maybe because I am honest, or maybe because I don't embellish myself too much? (Laughs) I am embarrassed so I won't say more.

n.zh: 記者：趙妍京 kjdculture@joongang.co.kr
n.en: BY CHO YEON-GYEONG kjdculture@joongang.co.kr
n.o: BY CHO YEON-GYEONG kjdculture@joongang.co.kr

items.title: 《勝利號》金泰梨：「張船長的笑臉 T 恤和外套，我都留下來當紀念品了。」（韓國日報）

en.title: Space Sweepers' Kim Tae-ri: "I Kept Captain Jang's Smiley-Face T-Shirt and Jacket as Souvenirs" (Hankook Ilbo)

n.zh: 《勝利號》的演員金泰梨透露，自己留下了飾演張船長時穿過的戲服，作為紀念品收藏。在 15 日下午進行的視訊訪談中，金泰梨笑著說：
n.en: Actress Kim Tae-ri revealed that she had received some of the costumes she wore as Captain Jang in Space Sweepers and kept them as souvenirs. During a video interview held on the afternoon of February 15, Kim Tae-ri laughed as she said:
n.o: '승리호'의 배우 김태리가 장선장 역할을 하며 입은 의상을 기념품으로 받았다고 고백했다. 김태리는 15일 오후 진행된 화상 인터뷰에서 "장선장이 영화 초반에 입었던 주황색 스마일 티셔츠, 그리고 세트인 재킷을 기념품으로 받았다"고 말하며 웃었다. 그는 "옷은 가지고 싶은 욕심이 나더라. 그래서 받았고, 그 전 작품에서도 의상 소품들은 자그마한 것들을 기념품으로 챙겨왔었다"고 회상했다.

a.zh: 「我收到了張船長在電影前半段穿的那件橘色笑臉 T 恤，還有和它搭配成一套的外套，作為紀念品。因為真的很想把那些衣服留下來。所以最後就拿到了。其實以前拍攝其他作品的時候，我也會留一些比較小的服裝配件或道具，當作紀念品收藏。」
a.en: “I received the orange smiley-face T-shirt that Captain Jang wears at the beginning of the film, along with the matching jacket, as souvenirs. I found myself really wanting to keep those clothes. So I got to take them home. Actually, even on previous projects, I've sometimes kept small costume pieces or props as mementos.”

n.zh: 此外，金泰梨也坦率地談到了拍攝過程中遇到的困難。
n.en: Kim Tae-ri also spoke candidly about the difficulties she encountered during filming.
n.o: 또한 김태리는 "감독님 머릿속에 영화에서 두 시간 보여지는 것보다 훨씬 큰 세계가 꽉 차게 들어있더라. 촬영하면서는 솔직히 어려움이 많았다. 내가 생각한 거보다 장선장 캐릭터가 단순하지 않았고 장르물의 어려운 지점이 있었다"고 털어놨다. 이어 "드라마가 흘러가면서 그에 맞는 호흡들로 연기를 하게 되는데 이건 생각지도 못한 일들이 터지게 되지 않나. 또 할리우드 영화에 학습된 부분이 있으니까 그런 데서 벗어나는데 시간이 걸렸다"고 덧붙였다.

a.zh:
「我發現，導演的腦海裡其實裝著一個非常龐大的世界。那個世界遠遠超過電影兩個小時的篇幅所能呈現的內容。老實說，拍攝的時候真的遇到了很多困難。張船長這個角色並沒有我原本想像的那麼單純，而且在演出這種類型電影時，也確實有一些特別困難的地方。

一般來說，隨著劇情逐漸發展，演員會順著故事的節奏，用符合當下情境的方式來表演。可是這部電影不一樣，故事裡會突然發生一些完全意想不到的事情。而且，我們多少已經受到過去看過的好萊塢電影影響，習慣了那些作品呈現這類場景的方式。所以，要擺脫那些既有的印象和表演模式，其實也花了我不少時間。」
a.en:
“I realized that the director had an enormous world fully developed in his mind. It was a world much bigger than what could be shown in the film's two-hour running time. To be honest, there were a lot of difficulties during filming. Captain Jang wasn't nearly as simple a character as I'd initially imagined, and there were certain challenges that came specifically from working in this genre.

Normally, as a story progresses, you act according to its flow and rhythm. But in this film, unexpected things keep happening, things you couldn't have anticipated. And because we've already been influenced by Hollywood films, we have certain preconceived ideas about how these situations are supposed to look and feel. It took me some time to break away from those familiar patterns.”

n.zh: 此外，她也提到了太空船內部布景帶給自己的感受。
n.en: She also described how the spaceship's interior set helped her performance.
n.o: 더불어 그는 "완벽히 세트 구현된 곳에서 촬영을 했고 그 안에서 생활감을 내는데는 너무 좋았다. 내가 생활하는 집처럼 꾸며져있으니까. 삐그덕거리는 소파, 발 올릴 수 있는 작은 의자, 심지어 오래 된 것 같은 냉장고도 있었다"면서 웃었다.

a.zh: 「我們是在一個幾乎完整搭建出來的攝影棚裡拍攝的。那樣的環境非常有助於呈現角色在那裡真實生活的感覺。因為整個空間被布置得就像是我平常生活的家一樣。裡面有一張坐上去會嘎吱嘎吱響的沙發。還有一張可以把腳放上去的小椅子。甚至連冰箱，看起來都像是已經用了很多年的舊冰箱。」
a.en: “We filmed on a set that had been almost completely built out. That made it much easier to create the feeling that we were actually living there. The whole place was decorated like a home I might really live in. There was a sofa that creaked when you sat on it. There was a little stool where you could rest your feet. There was even a refrigerator that looked as though it had been used for years.”

n.zh: 說到這裡，她笑了起來。
n.en: She laughed as she recalled the details.

n.zh: 金泰梨也坦言，自己花了很長一段時間，才逐漸習慣張船長的造型。
n.en: Kim Tae-ri admitted that it took her quite a while to get used to Captain Jang's appearance.
n.o: 김태리는 "장선장 룩에 적응하는데 오래 걸렸다. 스태프들에게 괜찮냐고 계속 물어봤다"면서 "감독님이 장선장은 선글라스를 껴야 한다고 해서 착용한 건데 그런 형태의 선글라스를 처음 껴봐서 적응하는데 시간이 좀 걸린 거 같다"고 밝혔다.

a.zh: 「我真的花了很久，才適應張船長的整體造型。那時候，我還一直問工作人員：『這樣真的可以嗎？看起來沒問題嗎？』因為導演認為張船長一定要戴墨鏡，所以我才戴上了那副墨鏡。可是，那種款式的墨鏡，我以前從來沒有戴過。所以我覺得，自己應該也是花了一些時間，才慢慢習慣那個樣子的。」
a.en: “It took me a long time to adjust to Captain Jang's overall look. I kept asking the staff: 'Does this look okay? Are you sure it's all right?' The director thought Captain Jang absolutely needed to wear sunglasses, so that's why I wore them. But I'd never worn sunglasses shaped like those before. I think that's why it took me some time to get used to the look.”

n.o: '승리호'는 2092년, 우주쓰레기 청소선 승리호의 선원들이 대량살상무기로 알려진 인간형 로봇 도로시를 발견한 후 위험한 거래에 뛰어드는 이야기를 그린 영화다. 김태리는 비상한 두뇌와 남다른 리더십으로 승리호를 이끄는 리더 장선장 역으로 분해 위풍당당한 걸크러시 매력을 보여준다. 김태리 외에도 송중기 진선규 유해진 등이 열연했다. '승리호'는 지난 5일 넷플릭스를 통해 전 세계 190여개국에 공개됐다. 이후 벨기에 불가리아 프랑스 덴마크 홍콩 러시아 등 총 28개 국가에서 최다 스트리밍 영화 1위에 오르며 관심을 입증했다.
n.zh:
《勝利號》的故事設定在 2092 年，描述太空垃圾清理船「勝利號」的船員們，在發現被認為是大規模殺傷性武器的人形機器人桃樂絲之後，捲入一場危險交易的故事。金泰梨在片中飾演以非凡頭腦和卓越領導能力帶領勝利號的張船長，展現出威風凜凜、帥氣強勢的女性魅力。

除了金泰梨之外，宋仲基、陳善圭、柳海真等演員也在電影中帶來精彩的表演。《勝利號》已於 2 月 5 日透過 Netflix 在全球約 190 個國家公開。上映之後，電影在比利時、保加利亞、法國、丹麥、香港、俄羅斯等共 28 個國家登上串流電影排行榜第一名，展現出受到的高度關注。
n.en:
Set in 2092, Space Sweepers tells the story of the crew of the space-debris collection ship Victory, who become involved in a dangerous deal after discovering a humanoid robot named Dorothy, believed to be a weapon of mass destruction. Kim Tae-ri plays Captain Jang, the leader of the Victory, whose exceptional intelligence and remarkable leadership skills make her a commanding presence. Through the role, she displays a bold, charismatic appeal.

The film also features performances by Song Joong-ki, Jin Sun-kyu, and Yoo Hae-jin. Space Sweepers was released on Netflix in approximately 190 countries worldwide on February 5. Following its release, it ranked as the most-streamed film in 28 countries and territories, including Belgium, Bulgaria, France, Denmark, Hong Kong, and Russia, demonstrating its widespread popularity.

items.title: 金泰梨如何成為韓國最炙手可熱的演員（The Korea Times）

en.title: How Kim Tae-ri Became Korea's Most Sought-After Actor (The Korea Times)

n.o:
The “Handmaiden” and “Little Forest” star Kim Tae-ri has emerged as one of Korea's most-sought-after young talents through a mix of boldness, curiosity and relentless focus. A mixture of confidence and vulnerability has made Kim a commanding presence since her debut in auteur Park Chan-wook's 2016 erotic thriller “The Handmaiden.” That performance ― she played a pickpocket named Sook-hee who conspires with conman Count Fujiwara (Ha Jung-woo) to swindle the wealthy Lady Hideko (Kim Min-hee) ― earned her multiple awards for best new actress.

Her profile has skyrocketed thanks to a string of projects ― including director Jang Joon-hwan's historical drama “1987” (2017) and Yim Soon-rye's “Little Forest” (2018), a film about finding solace in the beauty of the countryside.
n.zh:
憑藉著大膽、好奇心，以及始終如一的專注，曾出演《下女的誘惑》與《小森林》的金泰梨，如今已成為韓國最炙手可熱的年輕演員之一。自從 2016 年透過朴贊郁導演的情色驚悚電影《下女的誘惑》出道以來，金泰梨身上那種自信與脆弱並存的特質，便讓她展現出令人難以忽視的存在感。

她在電影中飾演扒手淑姬，與騙子藤原伯爵（河正宇飾）聯手設局，試圖騙取富家小姐秀子（金敏喜飾）的財產。憑藉這次演出，她獲得了多個最佳新人女演員獎項。此後，隨著一系列作品接連推出，她的知名度也迅速攀升。其中包括張駿桓導演的歷史電影《1987：黎明到來的那一天》（2017），以及林順禮導演執導的《小森林》（2018）。後者描寫的是一個人在鄉村的自然美景中，逐漸尋得心靈慰藉的故事。
n.en:
The “Handmaiden” and “Little Forest” star Kim Tae-ri has emerged as one of Korea's most-sought-after young talents through a mix of boldness, curiosity and relentless focus. A mixture of confidence and vulnerability has made Kim a commanding presence since her debut in auteur Park Chan-wook's 2016 erotic thriller “The Handmaiden.” That performance ― she played a pickpocket named Sook-hee who conspires with conman Count Fujiwara (Ha Jung-woo) to swindle the wealthy Lady Hideko (Kim Min-hee) ― earned her multiple awards for best new actress.

Her profile has skyrocketed thanks to a string of projects ― including director Jang Joon-hwan's historical drama “1987” (2017) and Yim Soon-rye's “Little Forest” (2018), a film about finding solace in the beauty of the countryside.

n.o: “I'm neither meticulous nor calculating. I just followed my heart and I was lucky to be given opportunities to work with the country's prominent directors and actors who I look up to very much,” she said during a Zoom interview with The Korea Times, Monday.
n.zh: 在週一透過 Zoom 接受《The Korea Times》採訪時，金泰梨表示：
n.en: she said during a Zoom interview with The Korea Times, Monday.

a.zh: 「我既不是一個做事特別縝密的人，也不是一個會精打細算、仔細盤算的人。我只是一直跟隨自己的心意去做選擇。而且我真的很幸運，能夠有機會和韓國那些優秀的導演，以及我非常敬佩的演員前輩們一起工作。」
a.en: “I'm neither meticulous nor calculating. I just followed my heart and I was lucky to be given opportunities to work with the country's prominent directors and actors who I look up to very much.”

n.zh: 金泰梨坦言，拍攝《勝利號》時，她所承受的壓力，比過去參與任何一部作品時都還要大。她說：
n.en: Kim revealed that she had more pressure on her shoulders when filming “Space Sweepers” than any other previous works.
n.o: Kim revealed that she had more pressure on her shoulders when filming “Space Sweepers” than any other previous works.

a.zh: 「老實說，拍完《下女的誘惑》之後，我完全沒有感受到票房方面的壓力。因為我很清楚自己的不足，也知道未來還有很多地方需要其他人的幫助。所以比起那些事情，我更在意的是該如何塑造、發展自己的角色。可是拍攝《勝利號》的時候，我感受到的壓力卻比平常更大。不過，我也試著學習放下那些壓力。因為即使感到不堪負荷，或是一直焦慮不安，也不會對表演帶來任何幫助。」
a.en: “Honestly, I felt zero pressure for box office success after 'The Handmaiden' because I was aware of my weaknesses and knew that I would need to get help from others. So I was more concerned about developing my characters,” she said. When filming 'Space Sweepers,' however, I had more pressure than usual. But I tried to let it go because feeling overwhelmed or anxious doesn't help when acting.”
a.o: “Honestly, I felt zero pressure for box office success after 'The Handmaiden' because I was aware of my weaknesses and knew that I would need to get help from others. So I was more concerned about developing my characters,” she said. When filming 'Space Sweepers,' however, I had more pressure than usual. But I tried to let it go because feeling overwhelmed or anxious doesn't help when acting.”

n.zh: 在《勝利號》中飾演張船長的金泰梨，也談到了演員們無論在鏡頭前或鏡頭外，都擁有非常好的默契。她表示：
n.en: Kim, who plays Captain Jang in “Space Sweepers,” explained that the ensemble cast had great chemistry on and off set.
n.o: Kim, who plays Captain Jang in “Space Sweepers,” explained that the ensemble cast had great chemistry on and off set.

a.zh: 「我們真的是一個完美的團隊。因為這是韓國第一部以外太空為背景的科幻電影，所以對每個人來說，都是一個全新的挑戰。演員們和製作團隊真的非常團結，大家一起努力，才終於完成了這部電影。對我而言，那是一段非常充實、很有成就感的經歷。」
a.o: “We were a perfect team. Because it is the first Korean sci-fi movie set in outer space, it was challenging and new to everyone. The actors and the production crew really worked together to bring the movie to completion, and it was a fulfilling experience,”
a.en: “We were a perfect team. Because it is the first Korean sci-fi movie set in outer space, it was challenging and new to everyone. The actors and the production crew really worked together to bring the movie to completion, and it was a fulfilling experience,”

n.o: she said. The actress said the film is
n.zh: 此外，金泰梨也形容《勝利號》是一部：
n.en: she said. The actress said the film is

a.zh: 「非常有人情味的電影。說到底，它其實是在講述人類之間的愛，以及對人類整體的關懷。」
a.en: “very human. It basically talks about love for humankind.”
a.o: “very human. It basically talks about love for humankind.”

n.o: Kim shared that every time she sees herself feeling low, she goes to bed or indulges in her hobbies such as baking, sewing or playing the piano.
n.zh: 金泰梨也分享了自己在情緒低落時，通常會如何調整心情。每當發現自己心情不好時，她就會去睡覺，或是投入自己喜歡的興趣之中。像是烘焙、縫紉，或是彈鋼琴，都是她會選擇做的事情。
n.en: Kim shared that every time she sees herself feeling low, she goes to bed or indulges in her hobbies such as baking, sewing or playing the piano.

n.o: Unafraid to try new things, Kim stayed in the United Kingdom for two months in 2019 to study English. She complained.
n.zh: 金泰梨向來不害怕嘗試新事物。2019 年，她曾經前往英國待了兩個月，專門學習英文。談起那段經歷，她有些抱怨地說：
n.en: Unafraid to try new things, Kim stayed in the United Kingdom for two months in 2019 to study English. She complained.

a.zh: 「多虧了那次經驗，我的英文真的進步了。可是現在又變生疏了。兩個月實在太短了啦。」
a.o: “Thanks to that experience, my English got better. But it got rusty again. Two months was too short."
a.en: “Thanks to that experience, my English got better. But it got rusty again. Two months was too short.”

n.o: The 31-year-old actress joined Instagram recently, where she uploaded old photos of herself in order to interact with her fans.
n.zh: 當時 31 歲的金泰梨，最近也開始使用 Instagram，並透過上傳自己過去的照片，與粉絲們互動。她笑著說：
n.en: The 31-year-old actress joined Instagram recently, where she uploaded old photos of herself in order to interact with her fans.

a.zh: 「其實一開始，我對於要不要使用社群媒體這件事，並不是很有把握。因為我也沒什麼經營社群帳號的想法，不太知道該怎麼使用它。不過，因為經紀公司建議我開設帳號，所以最後還是開始用了。而且，我現在還需要慢慢習慣在直播的時候，一邊看大家留言這件事。」（笑）
a.en: “I wasn't so sure about joining social media because there wasn't much idea about running it. Nonetheless I started it because my agency recommended it. I still need to get used to reading comments while livestreaming,” she laughed.
a.o: “I wasn't so sure about joining social media because there wasn't much idea about running it. Nonetheless, I started it because my agency recommended it. I still need to get used to reading comments while livestreaming,” she laughed.

n.o: Kim is currently filming director Choi Dong-hoon's “Alien,” a sci-fi blockbuster about aliens in the Joseon era.
n.zh: 金泰梨目前正在拍攝崔東勳導演執導的科幻鉅作《外星+人》，這部電影的故事涉及朝鮮時代與外星人。她表示：
n.en: Kim is currently filming director Choi Dong-hoon's “Alien,” a sci-fi blockbuster about aliens in the Joseon era.

a.zh: 「現在關於這部電影，我還沒有辦法透露任何內容。不過，我相信應該也會有很多人喜歡這部作品。」
a.en: “There's nothing I can say about the film at the moment, but I'm sure a lot of people would love that film too,” she said.

items.title: 金泰梨希望《勝利號》能啟發韓國創作出更多本土太空電影（韓聯社）

en.title: Actress Hopes Space Sweepers Inspires More Homegrown Space Films (Yonhap)

n.o:
When renowned South Korean director Park Chan-wook's 2016 erotic-psychological thriller "The Handmaiden" was released, a young actress playing a jaunty and independent teenage maid in the 1930s caught the eyes of movie fans and filmmakers.

She was Kim Tae-ri, then 26, who made her silver screen debut with the high profile project after being handpicked by Park from among 1,500 candidates who had auditioned for the role. Since then, her choices have drawn media attention and measured up to expectations in the critically acclaimed film "Little Forest" (2018) and the highly rated historical TV series "Mr. Sunshine" (2018).
n.zh:
2016 年，韓國知名導演朴贊郁執導的情色心理驚悚電影《下女的誘惑》上映時，一名年輕女演員吸引了電影觀眾與電影製作人的目光。她在片中飾演一位生活於 1930 年代、性格活潑大膽又獨立自主的年輕女僕。

她就是當時年僅 26 歲的金泰梨。金泰梨從 1,500 名參與試鏡的候選人中脫穎而出，獲得朴贊郁導演親自選中，透過這部備受矚目的作品正式登上大銀幕。從那之後，她的作品選擇始終受到媒體關注，也持續以表現回應外界的期待。其中包括獲得影評界高度讚賞的電影《小森林》（2018），以及收視表現亮眼的歷史電視劇《陽光先生》（2018）。
n.en:
When renowned South Korean director Park Chan-wook's 2016 erotic-psychological thriller "The Handmaiden" was released, a young actress playing a jaunty and independent teenage maid in the 1930s caught the eyes of movie fans and filmmakers. She was Kim Tae-ri, then 26, who made her silver screen debut with the high profile project after being handpicked by Park from among 1,500 candidates who had auditioned for the role.

Since then, her choices have drawn media attention and measured up to expectations in the critically acclaimed film "Little Forest" (2018) and the highly rated historical TV series "Mr. Sunshine" (2018).

n.zh: 這一次，金泰梨透過趙成熙導演執導的太空科幻電影《勝利號》回歸銀幕，飾演太空船「勝利號」的船長。週一，在接受韓聯社與其他韓國媒體透過 Zoom 進行的訪談時，她表示：
n.en: This time, Kim returned with space opera "Space Sweepers," directed by Jo Sung-hee, as the captain of the spaceship Victory.
n.o: This time, Kim returned with space opera "Space Sweepers," directed by Jo Sung-hee, as the captain of the spaceship Victory.

a.zh: 「第一次讀到《勝利號》的劇本時，我覺得故事真的非常有趣。可是，我卻完全無法想像自己出現在這部電影裡的模樣。通常讀劇本的時候，我會在腦海裡想像角色說話、行動的樣子。但在讀《勝利號》的劇本時，那種想像卻完全行不通。」
a.en: “When I first read the screenplay of 'Space Sweepers,' it was so interesting but I couldn't imagine myself playing a role in the film," she said Monday in a Zoom interview with Yonhap News Agency and other local news media. "I usually picture my character talking and moving in my head while I read a script. But as for 'Space Sweepers,' that imagination didn't work.”
a.o: “When I first read the screenplay of 'Space Sweepers,' it was so interesting but I couldn't imagine myself playing a role in the film," she said Monday in a Zoom interview with Yonhap News Agency and other local news media. "I usually picture my character talking and moving in my head while I read a script. But as for 'Space Sweepers,' that imagination didn't work.”

n.o:
"Space Sweepers" features a group of space scavengers who hunt for debris to make money in the year 2092 in a fictional universe where Earth is nearly destroyed by pollution and a group of upper class people build a new habitable world in outer space under the management of UTS Corporation.

Kim took the role of mysterious and charismatic Captain Jang, who leads the shabby spaceship Victory and three misfits -- pilot Tae-ho (Song Joong-ki), engineer Tiger Park (Jin Seon-kyu) and the humanoid robot Bubs (Yoo Hai-jin). The film is known to be the country's first space blockbuster film, a genre traditionally dominated by Hollywood studios with Western actors.
n.zh:
《勝利號》的故事背景設定在 2092 年。在這個虛構的宇宙世界裡，地球因為嚴重污染而幾乎遭到毀滅，而一群上層階級人士則在 UTS企業的管理下，於外太空建立了新的宜居世界。電影圍繞著一群太空垃圾清理工展開，他們在宇宙中四處搜尋廢棄物，藉此賺取生活所需的金錢。

金泰梨飾演神祕而充滿領袖氣場的張船長，率領著一艘破舊的太空船「勝利號」，以及三名性格各異、不太合群的船員。他們分別是駕駛員太浩（宋仲基飾）、輪機長朴老虎（陳善圭飾），以及人形機器人業童（柳海真飾）。這部電影被視為韓國首部大型太空科幻鉅作，而這種類型的電影，過去長期由好萊塢製片公司及西方演員主導。
n.en:
"Space Sweepers" features a group of space scavengers who hunt for debris to make money in the year 2092 in a fictional universe where Earth is nearly destroyed by pollution and a group of upper class people build a new habitable world in outer space under the management of UTS Corporation. Kim took the role of mysterious and charismatic Captain Jang, who leads the shabby spaceship Victory and three misfits -- pilot Tae-ho (Song Joong-ki), engineer Tiger Park (Jin Seon-kyu) and the humanoid robot Bubs (Yoo Hai-jin).

The film is known to be the country's first space blockbuster film, a genre traditionally dominated by Hollywood studios with Western actors.

n.zh: 金泰梨表示：

a.zh: 「導演告訴我，他想塑造的船長，並不是那種身材高大、強壯，看起來像女戰士一樣的人物。所以，他才選擇了我。可是，對我自己來說，要打破腦海裡對『船長』這個角色既有的刻板印象，其實很困難。因為在我的想像中，張船長根本不像我這樣的人。」
a.en: “The director told me that he wanted to create a captain who doesn't look like a female warrior with a bigger and stronger physique, so he cast me," she said. "But it was hard for me to break the stereotyped image of a captain. She didn't look like me.”
a.o: “The director told me that he wanted to create a captain who doesn't look like a female warrior with a bigger and stronger physique, so he cast me," she said. "But it was hard for me to break the stereotyped image of a captain. She didn't look like me.”

n.zh: 張船長原本是一名天才研究員，卻在試圖殺害 UTS 創辦人之後，成為一名太空垃圾清理工。為了讓這個角色在冷漠、面無表情的外表之下，也能展現出溫暖而有人情味的一面，金泰梨在表演中加入了一些細微的調整。她解釋：
n.en: So she put some tweaks on her character, a former genius researcher who became a space junk collector after attempting to kill the founder of UTS, in order to make Captain Jang look warm and humane behind her cold and deadpan face.
n.o: So she put some tweaks on her character, a former genius researcher who became a space junk collector after attempting to kill the founder of UTS, in order to make Captain Jang look warm and humane behind her cold and deadpan face.

a.zh: 「我覺得，如果張船長只是一個很酷、很有魅力，而且各方面都完美無缺的人，那樣反而會有點無趣。所以，我希望她偶爾也會有一點迷糊，有時候會被嚇到、顯得有些慌張。而且，她應該是一個能夠和船員們自然打成一片的人。因此，我就朝著這樣的方向去塑造張船長。」
a.en: “I thought it would be dreary if Captain Jang is just a cool and charismatic perfect person," she said. "So I created a captain who is slightly ditzy and skittish sometimes and mingles well with her crew members.”
a.o: “I thought it would be dreary if Captain Jang is just a cool and charismatic perfect person," she said. "So I created a captain who is slightly ditzy and skittish sometimes and mingles well with her crew members.”

n.o: Those complex and sophisticated characteristics explains the last choice that Captain Jang makes to save Dorothy, a young girl who possesses sought-after mysterious powers, and Earth, she noted.
n.zh: 金泰梨指出，張船長身上那些複雜而細膩的性格特質，也正好能夠解釋她在電影最後所做出的選擇。為了拯救擁有神祕力量、因此成為各方爭奪目標的小女孩桃樂絲，以及拯救地球，張船長最終做出了重要的決定。而這個選擇，正是建立在她多層次的人物性格之上。
n.en: Those complex and sophisticated characteristics explains the last choice that Captain Jang makes to save Dorothy, a young girl who possesses sought-after mysterious powers, and Earth, she noted.

n.o: Thanks to performance of the cast and quality computer-generated special visual effects, "Space Sweepers" has successfully created a buzz across the world to top Netflix's movie chart on its first week of its release on Feb. 5. Kim said the success of "Space Sweepers" verifies that imaginative and creative stories can be realized and dramatized on screen.
n.zh: 憑藉演員們的表現，以及高品質的電腦生成視覺特效，《勝利號》在全球引發了廣泛關注。電影於 2 月 5 日在 Netflix 上線後，首週便登上平台電影排行榜第一名。金泰梨認為，《勝利號》的成功證明了，那些充滿想像力與創意的故事，同樣能夠被實際製作出來，並透過大銀幕呈現給觀眾。
n.en: Thanks to performance of the cast and quality computer-generated special visual effects, "Space Sweepers" has successfully created a buzz across the world to top Netflix's movie chart on its first week of its release on Feb. 5. Kim said the success of "Space Sweepers" verifies that imaginative and creative stories can be realized and dramatized on screen.

n.zh: 金泰梨表示：

a.zh: 「我覺得，這真的是一個很好的開始。現在的韓國，已經沒有什麼故事是無法被實際拍出來的了。我想，這部電影應該也會為韓國許多電影製作人和編劇帶來啟發。我很期待，未來能夠看到更多充滿創意的原創作品。」
a.en: “I think it is a great start. There's no stories that cannot be realized now in Korea," she said. "It will probably inspire many filmmakers and writers here. I'm looking forward to seeing more creative originals in the future.”
a.o: “I think it is a great start. There's no stories that cannot be realized now in Korea," she said. "It will probably inspire many filmmakers and writers here. I'm looking forward to seeing more creative originals in the future.”

items.title: 金泰梨眼中的人①②③（Sports 京鄉）

en.title: Kim Tae-ri and the People Around Her ①②③ (Sports Kyunghyang)

n.o:
배우 김태리에겐 마력이 있다.

2016년 박찬욱 감독의 '아가씨'로 혜성처럼 나타나 '충무로 신데렐라'로 불리더니, 5년 만에 '믿고 보는 배우' 반열에 올라섰다. 히트작만 해도 줄줄이다. '1987' '리틀포레스트' '미스터 션샤인'에 이어 국내 최초 우주SF물인 넷플릭스 '승리호'까지 출연하면 모두 흥행으로 이어졌다.
n.zh: 演員金泰梨有一種魔力。2016 年，她透過朴贊郁導演的《下女的誘惑》如彗星般出現，被稱為「忠武路灰姑娘」；五年後，她已經躋身「值得信賴的演員」之列。她的熱門作品一部接一部。從《1987》、《小森林》、《陽光先生》，到韓國首部太空科幻作品 Netflix《勝利號》，出演的作品都接連取得成功。
n.en: Actress Kim Tae-ri has a certain magic. She appeared like a comet in 2016 through director Park Chan-wook's The Handmaiden and was called the “Cinderella of Chungmuro.” Five years later, she had risen to the ranks of actors audiences trust. Her hit works came one after another. From 1987, Little Forest, and Mr. Sunshine to Netflix's Space Sweepers, Korea's first space sci-fi film, each project she appeared in went on to find success.

a.o: “제 매력이요? 전혀 모르겠는데요. 감사하고 제 복이라고 생각해요. 하하.”
a.zh: 「我的魅力嗎？我完全不知道耶。很感謝，也覺得這是我的福氣。哈哈。」
a.en: “My charm? I have no idea at all. I'm grateful, and I think it's a blessing I've been given. Haha.”

n.o: '승리호'에선 카리스마 넘치는 '장선장'으로 분해 또 다른 얼굴을 보여준다. 전세계 190개국에 공개되자마자 뜨거운 반응이 올라왔고, 20여개국에선 넷플릭스 영화부문 1위를 하기도 했다.
n.zh: 在《勝利號》中，她化身為充滿領袖魅力的「張船長」，展現了另一種面貌。作品在全球 190 個國家公開後立刻獲得熱烈反應，並曾在 20 多個國家的 Netflix 電影排行榜登上第一名。
n.en: In Space Sweepers, she shows another side of herself as the charismatic Captain Jang. The film received an enthusiastic response as soon as it was released in 190 countries worldwide and ranked No. 1 in Netflix's film category in more than 20 countries.

a.o: “할리우드나 외국영화서 봤던 이미지가 각인돼 있을텐데, '승리호'는 한국어가 나오고 여러 나라 인물들이 자국어를 쓰니 신선하게 다가온 것 아닐까요? 삐그덕거리는 쇼파, 냉장고, 주전자처럼 지구에서 쓰던 소품들도 그대로 나오니, 한국적인 정감도 있고요.”
a.zh: 「大家腦中應該都已經有了在好萊塢或外國電影裡看過的那種形象吧。可是《勝利號》裡會出現韓語，各國人物也都說自己的語言，所以是不是因此讓人覺得很新鮮呢？而且像會吱嘎作響的沙發、冰箱、茶壺這些在地球上使用的物品也都原封不動地出現，所以也帶有一種韓國式的親切感。」
a.en: “People probably already have certain images imprinted in their minds from Hollywood or other foreign films. But in Space Sweepers, Korean is spoken, and characters from different countries use their own languages, so maybe that made it feel fresh. And things people used back on Earth, like a creaky sofa, a refrigerator, and a kettle, appear just as they are, so there's also a kind of Korean familiarity to it.”

n.o: 최근 '스포츠경향'이 만난 그는 겸손한 척 하지도, 젠 체하지도 않는 '자연스러움' 그대로였다. 6년차에 충무로 톱스타로 인정받은 이유는 어디에 있을까.
n.zh: 最近接受《Sports Kyunghyang》訪問時，她既不故作謙虛，也不裝腔作勢，就是保持著原本自然的樣子。出道第六年便獲得忠武路頂級明星的認可，原因究竟在哪裡呢？
n.en: When Sports Kyunghyang recently met her, she was simply natural — neither pretending to be modest nor putting on airs. What was the reason she had come to be recognized as a top Chungmuro star in her sixth year?

n.o:
■'진심이 최우선'…김태리의 비밀

신나게 달려온 배우 인생이지만 신기하게도 열애설이나 루머는 단 한 건도 없었다. 자기관리의 비결이 있을까.
n.zh:
■「真心最優先」……金泰梨的祕密

演員生涯一路愉快地奔跑至今，但神奇的是，她從未出現過任何戀愛傳聞或謠言。她有什麼自我管理的祕訣嗎？
n.en:
■ “Sincerity Comes First”… Kim Tae-ri's Secret

She has raced happily through her acting career so far, yet surprisingly, there has not been a single dating rumor or scandal. Was there a secret to how she managed herself?

a.o: “글쎄요. 다른 건 모르겠고, 사람을 대할 때 진심으로 대하려고 노력하고는 있습니다. 배우란 직업은 거짓말하기 쉬운 상황들이 다소 있거든요? 나쁜 의미가 아니라, 좋게 에둘러 말하기 위해서랄까. 혹은 이미지를 위해서 거짓말을 해야하는 지점이 있어요. 하하. 그 안에서 최대한 제 진심이 보여질 수 있게끔, 그리고 제 자신을 잃지 않으려고 노력하는 게 비결이라면 비결이죠.”
a.zh: 「不知道耶。其他的我不知道，不過在面對人的時候，我會努力真心地對待對方。演員這個職業，其實有不少很容易說謊的情況，不是嗎？不是什麼壞的意思，該怎麼說呢，可能是為了把話說得好聽一點、委婉一點。或者有些地方，為了形象也會需要說謊。哈哈。在那之中，我會盡量讓自己的真心能夠被看見，也努力不要失去自己。如果這也算是祕訣的話，那大概就是祕訣吧。」
a.en: “I'm not sure. I don't know about anything else, but when I deal with people, I do try to treat them sincerely. As an actor, there are quite a few situations where it's easy to lie, you know? Not in a bad way — maybe because you want to phrase something nicely or indirectly. Or there are times when you have to lie for the sake of your image. Haha. Within that, I try to make sure my sincerity shows as much as possible, and I try not to lose myself. If that counts as a secret, then I suppose that's my secret.”

n.o: 또 하나 자신을 지금의 위치로 이끈 건 주위의 '좋은 사람들' 덕분이라고 공을 돌렸다.
n.zh: 她也把自己能走到現在這個位置的另一個原因，歸功於身邊的「好人們」。
n.en: She also gave credit to the “good people” around her as another reason she had reached where she was.

a.o: “전 참 인복이 좋아요. 터질만큼 좋은 것 같아요. 좋은 사람들을 만나서 고민하지 않아도 좋은 환경에서 연기할 수 있었으니까요. 작품 하나를 함께하고 또 다시 만나기 쉽지 않다는데 유해진 선배처럼 좋은 사람과 연거푸 작품을 같이 하고 있으니 진짜 행복하죠. 좋은 인연 계속 유지했으면 좋겠어요.”
a.zh: 「我的人緣真的很好。好像好到快要爆炸的程度。因為遇到了好的人，所以可以在不用太過煩惱的好環境裡演戲。聽說一起合作過一部作品之後，要再度碰面其實並不容易。但像柳海真前輩這樣的好人，我卻能夠連續和他一起合作，真的很幸福。希望這些好的緣分可以一直維持下去。」
a.en: “I'm really blessed when it comes to people. It feels almost overwhelmingly good. Because I met good people, I was able to act in good environments without having to worry too much. They say it isn't easy to work with someone again after doing one project together. But I've been able to work repeatedly with a good person like Yoo Hae-jin sunbaenim, so I'm genuinely happy. I hope these good relationships continue.”

n.o: 마냥 즐거울 것 같아 보였지만, 지난해엔 자신의 작은 틀을 깨는 계기도 만났다.
n.zh: 雖然看起來似乎一直都很愉快，但在前一年，她也遇到了一個打破自己小框架的契機。
n.en: Although things may have seemed nothing but enjoyable, the previous year also gave her an opportunity to break out of her own small framework.

a.o: “변화의 해였어요. '승리호'를 큰 부담과 긴장 속에서 찍었거든요. 촬영을 마치고 배운 건 '주변을 잘 돌아보자, 날 사랑해주는 사람들을 생각하자'였어요. 그렇게 눈을 뜨니 절 응원하고 아끼는 사람들의 마음이 손끝으로도 다 전달되더라고요. 그 덕분에 제 마음도 풍요로워졌고, 예전보다 편해졌어요. 하지만 언젠가 또 불안의 시기가 오긴 하겠죠? 하하?”
a.zh: 「那是變化的一年。拍《勝利號》的時候，我一直處在很大的負擔和緊張之中。拍攝結束後，我學到的是：『好好看看自己的周圍吧，想想那些愛我的人吧。』當我那樣睜開眼去看的時候，那些支持我、珍惜我的人的心意，彷彿連透過指尖都能全部感受到。多虧如此，我的心也變得更豐富，比以前更自在了。不過，總有一天不安的時期還是會再來吧？哈哈？」
a.en: “It was a year of change. I filmed Space Sweepers under a lot of pressure and tension. What I learned after filming was over was, 'Look around you carefully. Think about the people who love you.' Once I opened my eyes that way, I could feel the hearts of the people who supported and cared for me, almost all the way to my fingertips. Thanks to that, my own heart became fuller, and I became more at ease than before. But someday another period of anxiety will probably come again, right? Haha?”

n.o:
배우 김태리는 자신의 장단점도 명확히 알고 있었다.

최근 '스포츠경향'과 만난 김태리는 배우로서 장단점을 묻자 바로 대답을 내놨다.
n.zh: 演員金泰梨也很清楚自己的優點和缺點。最近接受《Sports Kyunghyang》訪問時，被問到作為演員的優缺點，她立刻給出了回答。
n.en: Kim Tae-ri also knew her own strengths and weaknesses clearly. When Sports Kyunghyang recently asked about her strengths and weaknesses as an actor, she answered immediately.

a.o: “열심히 한다는 게 제 장점이에요. 최선을 다하고 노력도 하죠. 그런데 단점은 유리멘탈이라는 점이에요. 겉으론 당당해 보여도 실제 그렇지 않거든요. 종종 집에 가서 이불도 차고 '내가 왜 그랬지' 곱씹어보기도 하고요. 다행인 건 순간접착제로 부숴진 멘탈을 빨리 붙여서 일할 수 있다는 거에요.”
a.zh: 「我的優點是很努力。我會盡全力，也會努力去做。但缺點就是，我的心態很像玻璃一樣脆弱。表面上看起來好像很有自信，其實不是那樣。有時候回到家，還會踢被子，一直反覆想：『我當時為什麼要那樣？』幸好的是，我可以用瞬間膠很快把碎掉的心態黏回去，然後繼續工作。」
a.en: “My strength is that I work hard. I do my best and put in effort. But my weakness is that I have a very fragile mentality. I may look confident on the outside, but I'm actually not like that. Sometimes I go home, kick the blankets, and keep thinking, 'Why did I do that?' Fortunately, I can quickly glue my broken mentality back together with superglue and get back to work.”

n.o: 데뷔 후 늘 화제의 중심에 서온 그다. 일거수일투족 모두 이슈가 됐다. 초등학교 졸업사진부터 대학교 과거 사진까지 많은 이에게 관심을 받았다. 최근엔 팬들과 소통하기 위해 SNS도 개설했다. 소속사의 요청으로 시작했다지만, 첫 사진 업로드부터 화제가 됐다.
n.zh: 出道之後，她一直站在話題中心，一舉一動都成為焦點。從小學畢業照到大學時期的舊照，都受到許多人關注。最近她也為了和粉絲交流開設了 SNS。雖然是應所屬公司的要求開始經營，但從上傳第一張照片開始就引起話題。
n.en: Since debut, Kim has constantly stood at the center of attention, with nearly every move becoming an issue. From her elementary school graduation photo to old university pictures, many people showed interest. Recently, she also opened a social media account to communicate with fans. Although she started it at her agency's request, even her very first photo upload became a topic of discussion.

a.o: “초등학교 졸업사진은 솔직히 정말 부끄러워요. 저는 감추고 싶었는데, 아마 동창생 중 하나가 퍼뜨렸겠죠? 하하. 신기한 건 팬들이 그걸 엄청 색다르게 해석해주더라고요. 영화 캐릭터로 봐주는 것 때문에 웃어넘겼죠. 팬들이야 못 보던 사진을 보면 너무 좋아하니까, 그런 걸 SNS에 하나 둘씩 올려주면 즐거워할 것 같더라고요.”
a.zh: 「老實說，小學畢業照真的讓我很害羞。我本來是想藏起來的，大概是某個同學把它傳出去的吧？哈哈。有趣的是，粉絲們居然會用非常不一樣的方式去解讀那張照片。因為大家把它當成電影角色來看，所以我也就笑著帶過了。粉絲們看到以前沒看過的照片都會很開心，所以我想，如果把那種照片一張、兩張放到 SNS 上，他們應該也會覺得很開心。」
a.en: “Honestly, my elementary school graduation photo is really embarrassing. I wanted to hide it, but I guess one of my classmates must have spread it, right? Haha. What's interesting is that fans interpreted it in really unusual ways. They looked at it as if it were a film character, so I just laughed it off. Fans get so happy when they see photos they've never seen before, so I thought they might enjoy it if I uploaded things like that to social media one by one.”

n.o: 천생 배우다. 만약 이 길로 들어서지 않았으면 어땠을까. 상상력이 풍부하지 않아 뭘 할진 모르겠지만 잘 살고는 있을 거라며 호탕한 웃음을 터뜨리는 그다. 어떤 질문에도 솔직하고 유쾌한 그에게 '꼭 지키는 신념이 있느냐'는 물음표를 슬쩍 던졌다.
n.zh: 她似乎天生就是演員。如果沒有走上這條路，會是什麼樣子呢？她豪爽地笑著說，自己想像力不太豐富，所以不知道會做什麼，但應該還是會過得很好。面對任何問題都坦率又愉快的她，記者接著問道：「有沒有一定會堅守的信念？」
n.en: She seems like a born actor. What would she have been like if she had not taken this path? She burst into a hearty laugh, saying she was not very imaginative, so she had no idea what she would have done, but she was sure she would have lived well. To Kim, who answered every question with honesty and good humor, the reporter then asked whether there was any belief she made sure to hold onto.

a.o: “나 자신을 사랑하는 거요. 그게 가장 중요하다고 생각해요. 나 자신을 사랑한다면 주위를 사랑했으면 좋겠고요. 그외에도 모르는 사람들에게까지 그 사랑을 나눠줄 수 있었으면 해요. 배우로서, 사람으로서 꼭 그랬으면 좋겠어요.”
a.zh: 「愛自己。我覺得那是最重要的。如果能愛自己，我也希望自己能夠去愛身邊的人。除此之外，也希望能把那份愛分享給甚至不認識的人。不管作為演員，還是作為一個人，我都希望自己一定能做到那樣。」
a.en: “Loving myself. I think that's the most important thing. If I love myself, I hope I can also love the people around me. And beyond that, I hope I can share that love even with people I don't know. As an actor and as a person, I really hope I can live that way.”

n.zh: 對演員金泰梨而言，「人」是一個非常重要的課題。尤其在拍攝現場，她格外重視與他人之間的「溝通」。而這次能夠順利完成趙成熙導演執導的 Netflix 電影《勝利號》，並從中獲得滿滿的成就感，很大一部分也來自她與合作演員之間默契十足的配合。金泰梨表示：
n.en: For actress Kim Tae-ri, “people” are an important part of her life and work. On set, she places particular importance on communication with those around her. Much of the satisfaction she feels from successfully completing the Netflix film Space Sweepers, directed by Jo Sung-hee, also comes from the excellent chemistry she shared with her fellow cast members. Kim Tae-ri explained:
n.o: 배우 김태리에겐 '사람'이 중요한 화두다. 촬영 현장에선 특히나 사람들과 '소통'을 중시한다. 넷플릭스 영화 '승리호'(감독 조성희) 작업을 성공적으로 마쳤다는 만족감도, 함께한 동료들과 찰떡 호흡 때문이다.

a.zh: 「我真的非常依賴宋仲基、柳海真、陳善圭等前輩們。和他們三個人都非常合得來，而且大家都對我很好。我也真的從他們身上得到了非常多的幫助。」
a.en: “I relied a lot on my senior co-stars, including Song Joong-ki, Yoo Hae-jin, and Jin Sun-kyu. I got along really well with all three of them, and they treated me very kindly. They also helped me a tremendous amount.”
a.o: “송중기, 유해진, 진선규 선배 등 모두에게 의지를 많이 했어요. 세 사람 다 잘 맞았고, 제게 잘해줬거든요. 도움도 정말 많이 받았고요.”

n.zh: 電影《勝利號》演員陣容。最近接受採訪時，當被問到《勝利號》的合作演員之中，誰的個性和自己最相似，金泰梨毫不猶豫地選擇了陳善圭。她笑著說：
n.en: The cast of Space Sweepers. During a recent interview, Kim Tae-ri was asked which of her Space Sweepers co-stars had a personality most similar to her own. Without hesitation, she chose Jin Sun-kyu.
n.o: 영화 '승리호' 출연진. 최근 만난 김태리에게 가장 성격이 비슷한 사람은 누구냐고 했더니 단박에 진선규를 꼽았다.

a.zh: 「他跟我真的非常像。我們都不太會直接相信導演說的話，總是會有點懷疑。（哈哈）也會一直煩惱，自己到底有沒有把戲演好。而且，如果前一天拍攝時有什麼地方覺得不滿意，隔天還是會放不下。會一直惦記著那件事，反覆追究、糾結到底。」
a.en: “We're really similar. Neither of us easily takes the director's words at face value. We tend to question things. Haha. We constantly worry about whether we've performed our scenes properly. And if there's something we're dissatisfied with from the previous day's filming, we can't just let it go. We bring those regrets with us the next day and keep dwelling on them, trying to work things out.”
a.o: “저랑 되게 비슷해요. 감독 말 잘 안 믿고 의심하고요. 하하. 연기를 제대로 했는지를 계속 고민하고. 또 전날 아쉬움을 못 버리고 와서 물고 늘어지죠.”

n.zh: 此外，金泰梨也稱讚了宋仲基成熟穩重的一面。
n.en: Kim Tae-ri also praised Song Joong-ki for his maturity.
n.o: 송중기의 어른스러운 면을 칭찬하기도 했다.

a.zh:
「他真的很帥氣，是個很了不起的人。就像船長一樣。他很有正義感，對於什麼是對、什麼是錯，有非常清楚的判斷。而且，他很愛人，也很關心身邊的人。如果要說到會好好照顧工作人員的演員，我覺得他絕對是最出色的那種人。他會記住工作人員每一個人的名字，叫他們的名字。

也會分別請不同團隊的工作人員吃飯，把大家都照顧得很好。他真的很擅長凝聚大家，讓所有人融洽地相處。」
a.en: “He's really admirable. He's like a captain. He has a strong sense of justice and a very clear understanding of what's right and wrong. He genuinely loves and cares about people. When it comes to actors who take good care of the staff, I'd say he's one of the very best. He calls each staff member by name and even treats different teams to meals. He's incredibly good at bringing everyone together and making sure people feel included and cared for.”
a.o: “참 멋있어요. 선장 같은 사람이죠. 정의롭고, 옳고 그름이 정확해요. 사람을 사랑하고요. 스태프 잘 챙기는 배우론 최고라고 할 수 있어요. 한명 한명 이름을 부르면서 팀별로 밥도 사고 잘 아우르더라고요.”

n.zh: 而另一位不能不提的合作夥伴，則是在電影中飾演「花妮」的童星朴藝隣。金泰梨回憶道：
n.en: Another unforgettable co-star was Park Ye-rin, the young actress who played Kot-nim. Kim Tae-ri recalled:
n.o: 함께 연기한 '꽃님이' 박예린도 빼놓을 수 없는 동료다.

a.zh:
「她在拍攝現場，也和電影裡看到的一樣，活潑得不得了，充滿了朝氣。真的非常可愛、非常討人喜歡。對我們來說，她就像陽光一樣的存在。拍攝過程中，難免會有疲倦、辛苦的時候。可是，那孩子總是能突然逗得大家哈哈大笑，讓我們笑個不停。

她甚至連對導演說話，都會毫不客氣地開玩笑、想到什麼就直接說出來。噗哈哈！多虧有她，我們才能在那麼多辛苦的時刻裡，依然開開心心地完成拍攝。」
a.en: “She was just as bubbly and full of energy on set as she was in the movie. She was absolutely adorable. To all of us, she was like a ray of sunshine. There were plenty of times when filming became exhausting and difficult. But she was always making us burst into laughter, so we laughed a lot. She would even casually throw out jokes and comments to the director without holding back. Hahaha! Thanks to her, we were able to have a really fun and enjoyable time filming, even when things got tough.”
a.o: “영화에서 보는 것처럼 현장에서도 '깨발랄'했어요. 정말 예뻤고, 저희에겐 햇살 같은 존재였죠. 촬영하다보면 지치고 힘들 때도 많았는데, 그 친구가 항상 빵빵 터뜨려줘서 많이 웃었어요. 감독에게도 막 던지더라고요. 푸하하. 덕분에 재밌게 잘 촬영할 수 있었어요.”

items.title: 金泰梨從宋仲基身上學到的事①②（韓國經濟）

en.title: What Kim Tae-ri Learned from Song Joong-ki ①② (Hankyung)

n.o:
조성희 감독 신작 '승리호'로 돌아온 김태리
"국내 최초 우주 SF, 부담 보다 설렘"
n.zh:
金泰梨以趙聖熙導演的新作《勝利號》回歸
「韓國首部太空科幻片，比起負擔，更多的是興奮」
n.en:
Kim Tae-ri returns with director Jo Sung-hee's new film Space Sweepers
“Korea's first space sci-fi film — I felt more excitement than pressure”

n.o: 배우 김태리가 '승리호'에 대한 자신감을 드러냈다.
n.zh: 演員金泰梨展現了對《勝利號》的自信。
n.en: Actress Kim Tae-ri expressed confidence in Space Sweepers.

n.o: 15일 진행된 온라인 인터뷰에서 김태리는 한국 최초 우주 블록버스터 '승리호' 출연 소감에 대해 "두근두근했다"고 말했다.
n.zh: 在 15 日進行的線上訪談中，談到出演韓國首部太空大片《勝利號》的感想，金泰梨表示：
n.en: In an online interview held on the 15th, Kim described how she felt about appearing in Korea's first space blockbuster, Space Sweepers:

a.zh: 「很讓人心跳加速。」
a.en: “My heart was pounding with excitement.”

n.o: 김태리는 "관객으로 SF 너무 좋아한다. SF 영화는 있었지만, 우주는 처음이니까 최초라는게 너무 설렜다"고 밝혔다. 그는 캐스팅 제안을 받고 만난 조성희 감독의 세계관에 깜짝 놀랐다고. "감독 머리속에 2시간 보여지는 것보다 훨씬 큰 세계가 있었다. 장선장 캐릭터도 좋았다"고 말했다.
n.zh: 金泰梨表示：
n.en: Kim said:

a.zh: 「身為觀眾，我非常喜歡科幻作品。之前雖然也有科幻電影，但太空題材是第一次，所以『首次』這件事讓我非常興奮。」
a.en: “As a viewer, I really love sci-fi. There had been sci-fi films before, but space was a first, so the fact that it was the first made me really excited.”

n.zh: 她也表示，在收到選角邀請並見到趙聖熙導演之後，對導演所建構的世界觀感到非常驚訝。
n.en: She also said she was surprised by director Jo Sung-hee's worldview after meeting him following the casting offer.

a.zh: 「導演腦中的世界，比電影兩個小時所呈現出來的還要大得多。張船長這個角色我也很喜歡。」
a.en: “There was a much bigger world in the director's head than what could be shown in two hours. I also liked the character of Captain Jang.”

n.o:
'승리호'는 10년 가까이 세계관을 창조한 조성희 감독의 창의력과 1000여 명의

VFX(시각특수효과) 전문가가 참여해 현실감 넘치는 우주를 구현한 한국 기술력의 정수를 선보였다는 평가를 받고 있다.
n.zh: 《勝利號》由趙聖熙導演花費近 10 年打造世界觀，並有約 1,000 名 VFX（視覺特效）專家參與。作品以極具真實感的太空場景，被評價為展現了韓國技術力的精華。
n.en: Space Sweepers has been praised for presenting the best of Korean technical capabilities, combining director Jo Sung-hee's creativity in building its world over nearly ten years with the work of around 1,000 VFX specialists to create a highly realistic vision of space.

n.o: 촬영을 하면서 어려운 점은 김태리의 상상보다 많았다. "생각했던 것 보다 단순하지도 않았고 장르물이라 어려운 부분이 있었다"고 했다. 그는 "드라마는 흘러 가며 그에 맞는 호흡으로 연기를 하게 되는데 '승리호'는 생각지 못하는 일들이 터진다. 강도가 헷갈렸다. 다른 할리우드 영화를 보고 학습된 부분이 있어 벗어나는 데 시간이 걸렸다"고 털어놨다.
n.zh: 實際拍攝時遇到的困難，比金泰梨原先想像的更多。她說：
n.en: The difficulties Kim encountered during filming were greater than she had imagined. She said:

a.zh: 「它不像我原本想的那麼單純，而且因為是類型片，也有一些困難的地方。」
a.en: “It wasn't as simple as I had expected, and because it was a genre film, there were difficult parts.”

n.zh: 她接著坦言：
n.en: She continued:

a.zh: 「一般戲劇會隨著劇情流動，演員也會按照那個節奏去演。但《勝利號》裡會突然發生一些意想不到的事情，所以我會搞不清楚表演的強度該到什麼程度。因為我也有一些從其他好萊塢電影裡看來、學到的東西，所以花了一點時間才從那些既有印象裡脫離出來。」
a.en: “In a drama, the story flows and you act according to that rhythm. But in Space Sweepers, unexpected things suddenly happen, so I found it confusing to judge the intensity of the performance. There were also things I had learned from watching other Hollywood films, so it took some time to break away from those preconceptions.”

n.o: 장르에 대한 부담감을 느꼈냐는 질문에 김태리는 "부담감 보다는 설렘과 기대감이 컸다"면서 "저는 약간 '최초'는 다 잘 돼라는 생각이 있다. 할리우드에서만 보던 우주 활극을 한국 영화에서 한국 배우들이 연기한다는 것과 거기 제 얼굴이 있다는 것에 대한 기대가 컸다"며 웃었다.
n.zh: 被問到是否對這個類型感到負擔時，金泰梨回答：
n.en: Asked whether she felt pressure about the genre, Kim replied:

a.zh: 「比起負擔，我更多的是興奮和期待。」
a.en: “I felt more excitement and anticipation than pressure.”

n.zh: 她笑著說：
n.en: She laughed and added:

a.zh: 「我有一點『第一次做的東西都會成功』這樣的想法。以前只有在好萊塢電影裡看過的太空冒險動作片，現在由韓國電影、韓國演員來演，而且我的臉也出現在裡面，這件事讓我非常期待。」
a.en: “I have this idea that 'firsts always turn out well.' I was really excited by the fact that the kind of space adventure we had only seen in Hollywood films would now be performed by Korean actors in a Korean film — and that my face would be in it too.”

n.o: 조성희 감독에 대해 김태리는 '수줍은 고집쟁이 천재'라고 생각한다고. 그러면서도 "감독이 오케이를 너무 쉽게 하신다. 물론 감독님 머리 속에 다 있지만, 저는 의심이 가는 거다. 충분해서인지, 이 정도면 됐어인지 고민했다. 감독께 여쭤보면 다 좋다고 한다. 저는 좀 더 이끌어주셨으면 했는데 허허벌판에 놓인 느낌이 있었다. 고군분투했다"고 귀띔했다.
n.zh: 金泰梨形容趙聖熙導演是「害羞又固執的天才」。不過她也說：
n.en: Kim described director Jo Sung-hee as “a shy, stubborn genius.” At the same time, she said:

a.zh: 「導演太容易喊 OK 了。當然，導演腦子裡都有他的想法，但我就會產生懷疑。我會想，到底是真的已經足夠好了，還是只是覺得『做到這程度就行了』。去問導演的話，他又都說很好。我其實希望他能再多帶我一點，但有時候會有種自己被放在一片空曠原野上的感覺。所以我自己苦戰了一番。」
a.en: “The director says 'okay' too easily. Of course, he has everything in his head, but I would start to doubt. I wondered whether it was because what I did was truly enough, or whether he simply thought, 'This is good enough.' Whenever I asked him, he would say everything was good. I wanted him to guide me a little more, but sometimes I felt as though I had been left out in a wide-open field. So I struggled through it on my own.”

n.o: 영화 '승리호'에서 김태리는 한때 악명 높은 우주 해적단의 선장으로 신분을 바꾼 후 우주 쓰레기 청소선 승리호를 이끄는 장 선장 역을 맡았다. 장 선장은 막말을 기본으로 탑재하고 안하무인 성격 탓에 우주노동자들도 혀를 내두르지만, 비상한 두뇌로 못 다루는 기게가 없고 남다른 리더십을 발휘한다. '승리호'에서 가장 이성적이고 현실적인 인물로 혼란에 빠진 상황에서도 흔들리지 않고, 정의롭지 못한 일에 단호히 대처한다.
n.zh: 在電影《勝利號》中，金泰梨飾演張船長。她曾是惡名昭彰的太空海盜團船長，之後改變身分，帶領太空垃圾清理船「勝利號」。張船長說話本來就很不客氣，加上目中無人的性格，就連太空勞工們也拿她沒辦法；但她頭腦出眾，沒有不會操作的機械，也展現出與眾不同的領導能力。她是《勝利號》中最理性、最現實的人物，即使陷入混亂的情況也不會動搖，面對不正義的事情時則會果斷處理。
n.en: In Space Sweepers, Kim Tae-ri plays Captain Jang. Once the captain of a notorious space pirate crew, she later changes her identity and leads the space-junk collecting ship Victory. Captain Jang is naturally foul-mouthed and so arrogant that even space workers shake their heads at her, but with her exceptional intelligence, there is hardly a machine she cannot operate, and she displays remarkable leadership. She is the most rational and realistic character in Space Sweepers, remaining steady even in chaotic situations and responding firmly to injustice.

n.o: '승리호' 내부는 완벽한 세트였다. 김태리는 "내부에 CG가 없었기에 그 안에서 생활감을 내기 좋았다.'SF니까 이렇게 해야해' 라기보다 일상적인 집 같이 되어 있었다. 단 장 선장의 모든 룩에 적응하는데 시간이 오래 걸렸다. 주변의 스태프, 감독이 '괜찮냐'고 계속 물어봤다. 선글라스도 감독의 제안으로 착용했다. 그런 형태의 선글라스를 처음 껴봐서 적응하는데 시간이 걸렸다"며 너스레를 떨었다.
n.zh: 「勝利號」內部是完整搭建的實景布景。金泰梨說：
n.en: The interior of the Victory was built as a complete physical set. Kim said:

a.zh: 「因為內部沒有 CG，所以很容易在裡面表現出生活感。比起『因為是科幻，所以一定要這樣做』，它更像是一個日常生活的家。不過，要適應張船長所有的造型，真的花了很長時間。旁邊的工作人員和導演一直問我『還好嗎？』太陽眼鏡也是導演提議要戴的。我以前沒戴過那種款式的太陽眼鏡，所以也花了一些時間適應。」
a.en: “Because there was no CG inside, it was easy to create a lived-in feeling. Rather than thinking, 'It's sci-fi, so it has to be like this,' it felt more like an ordinary home. But it took me a long time to get used to all of Captain Jang's looks. The staff and the director around me kept asking, 'Are you okay?' The sunglasses were also the director's suggestion. I had never worn that kind of sunglasses before, so it took me some time to get used to them.”

n.o:
이어 "장르적인 메리트라고 생각한다. 각 캐릭터마다 트레이드 마크가 되는 것들이 인물에 캐릭터를 부여하고 구체적으로 만들어준다. 연기 외적인 부분에서 인물을 더 녹아내리게 하는 매력이 있다. 처음에 장 선장은 오렌지 컬러를 부여 받았다. 우주복을 입었을 때, 내가 지금까지 상상하던 모양새가 아니었다. 이래도 되나 싶을 정도. 승리호 안에서 보니 색깔들이

매력적이더라"라고 했다.
n.zh: 她接著說：
n.en: She continued:

a.zh: 「我覺得這就是類型片的優點。每個角色都有屬於自己的標誌性元素，這些東西會替人物增加性格，也讓角色變得更具體。它有一種從演技以外的部分，讓人物更加自然融進去的魅力。一開始，張船長被設定為橘色。穿上太空衣的時候，完全不是我一直以來想像中的樣子。甚至會讓我想『這樣真的可以嗎？』但放到勝利號裡面一看，反而覺得那些顏色很有魅力。」
a.en: “I think that's one of the advantages of genre films. Each character has trademark elements that give them more character and make them more concrete. There's an appeal in how things outside the acting itself help the character blend in more fully. At first, Captain Jang was assigned the color orange. When I put on the spacesuit, it looked nothing like what I had imagined. It was to the point where I wondered, 'Is this really okay?' But once I saw it inside the Victory, I found the colors appealing.”

n.o: 현장에서 놀란 부분은 세심한 배려였다. 그는 "장 선장과 태호가 앉은 의자는 전동 의자였다. 우주선이 역동적으로 움직일때 같이 움직인다. '덜컹' 하는 부분은 배우들이 연기하려면 뻔뻔해야 하고 어려운 부분이다. 연기하는 데 깨지 않게 많은 도움을 받았다"고 말했다.
n.zh: 讓她在片場感到驚訝的，是製作上的細心照顧。她說：
n.en: What surprised her on set was the attention to detail.

a.zh: 「張船長和泰浩坐的椅子是電動椅。太空船劇烈移動時，椅子也會跟著一起動。像『喀噔』那種晃動，如果要演員自己演出來，就得很厚著臉皮去做，其實是很難的部分。這些設備給了我很多幫助，讓我在表演時不會出戲。」
a.en: “The chairs Captain Jang and Tae-ho sat in were motorized. When the spaceship moved dynamically, the chairs moved with it. For actors to perform those jolting movements themselves, you have to be pretty shameless about it, and it's difficult. The equipment helped a lot so that I wouldn't be pulled out of the performance.”

n.o: 장 선장 캐릭터 호평에 대해 "전형적이지 않다는 부분은 감독께 공을 돌리고 싶다"고 강조했다. 그는 "시나리오를 보고 제일 먼저 여쭤본 건 '왜 저를 캐스팅 하고 싶으시냐'였다. 시나리오를 볼 때 제 얼굴로 읽히지는 않았다. 앞서 했던 다른 작품들은 대사를 읽으면 내가 그 안에 있는 모습이 쉽게 떠올랐다면, '승리호'는 잘 떠오르지 않았다. 하고 싶었지만 왜 날까?라는 생각을 했다"고 털어놨다.
n.zh: 對於張船長這個角色獲得好評，金泰梨強調：
n.en: Regarding the positive response to Captain Jang, Kim emphasized:

a.zh: 「關於她不落入典型這一點，我想把功勞歸給導演。」
a.en: “I want to give the director credit for the fact that she isn't a stereotypical character.”

n.zh: 她說：
n.en: She said:

a.zh: 「我看完劇本之後，第一個問導演的問題就是：『為什麼想找我演？』讀劇本的時候，我並沒有辦法用自己的臉去想像這個角色。之前拍過的其他作品，只要讀台詞，就很容易想像自己在那個作品裡的樣子。但《勝利號》不太一樣，我很難想像出來。雖然很想演，但同時也會想：『為什麼是我？』」
a.en: “The first thing I asked after reading the screenplay was, 'Why do you want to cast me?' When I read the script, I couldn't really picture the character with my face. With my previous works, when I read the dialogue, it was easy to imagine myself inside them. But with Space Sweepers, that image didn't come easily. I wanted to do it, but at the same time I wondered, 'Why me?'”

n.o: 김태리는 "선장이라는 타이틀이 과격하고 우락부락할 것 같은 인물이라고 생각하지만 힘이 없을 것 같은 사람이 조종석에 앉아 있을 때 더 큰 효과가 날 거라고 믿으셨다고 했다. 그렇게 저를 설득 해주셨다"고 설명했다.
n.zh: 金泰梨解釋：
n.en: Kim explained:

a.zh: 「一般會覺得，掛著『船長』這個頭銜的人，應該是比較強悍、粗獷的形象。但導演說，他相信如果是一個看起來好像沒什麼力量的人坐在駕駛座上，反而會產生更大的效果。他就是這樣說服我的。」
a.en: “You might imagine that someone with the title of captain would be rough and physically imposing. But the director said he believed it would have a greater effect if someone who looked as though they had little physical strength were sitting in the pilot's seat. That was how he convinced me.”

n.o: 김태리는 이에 대해 "너무 신기했다"며 밝게 웃었다. 그는 "해외에 있는 지인들이 저와 같은 시간에 영화를 보고, 연락을 줬다. '아가씨'도 1~2년 지나 해외에서 개봉됐고 그 후에 해외 관객의 리뷰를 들었다. '승리호'는 같은 시각에 바로 반응이 오니 신기했다. 주변에서 '전세계 1위' 막 이러셔서 저는 '아유 뭘요'라고 하면서도 속으론 굉장히 설레여 하고 있다. 더 많은 분들이 볼 수 있다는 점이 가장 큰 메리트였다"고 만족감을 드러냈다.
n.zh: 對此，金泰梨燦爛地笑著說：
n.en: Kim smiled brightly and said:

a.zh: 「真的覺得很神奇。」
a.en: “It was really fascinating.”

n.zh: 她接著說：
n.en: She continued:

a.zh: 「人在海外的朋友們可以和我在同一個時間看電影，然後馬上聯絡我。《下女的誘惑》也是過了一、兩年才在海外上映，之後我才會聽到海外觀眾的評價。但《勝利號》是在同一時間立刻就有反應，所以真的很神奇。身邊的人一直說什麼『全世界第一名』，我表面上就會說『哎唷，哪有啦』，但其實心裡非常興奮。能讓更多人看到這部電影，我覺得這是最大的優點。」
a.en: “People I know overseas were able to watch the film at the same time as I did and contact me right away. The Handmaiden was released overseas one or two years later, and only then did I hear reviews from international audiences. But with Space Sweepers, the reactions came immediately at the same time, so that felt fascinating. People around me kept saying things like, 'It's No. 1 worldwide,' and I would say, 'Oh, come on,' but inside I was actually really excited. The biggest advantage was that more people could see it.”

n.zh:
出道進入第六年的金泰梨，雖然演出作品的數量不算多，履歷卻相當充實。從朴贊郁導演的電影《下女的誘惑》中華麗地登上商業電影舞台，到以朴鍾哲遭刑求致死事件為背景的電影《1987：黎明到來的那一天》，再到林順禮導演的《小森林》，以及金銀淑編劇的電視劇《陽光先生》。

金泰梨透過一次次跳脫既定框架的作品選擇，自然而然地詮釋出身處不同時代、擁有不同性格的人物。她也是少數能讓觀眾深刻感受到，見證一位新生代演員逐漸成長，是多麼令人愉快的一件事的演員。而這一次，金泰梨化身為《勝利號》中充滿領袖氣場的船長，帶領觀眾前往 2092 年的宇宙。

在電影《勝利號》中，金泰梨飾演張船長。她曾經是惡名昭彰的太空海盜團船長，之後改變身分，開始率領太空垃圾清理船「勝利號」。這部電影的一大看點，便是演員們之間的默契。談到飾演太浩的宋仲基、飾演業童的柳海真，以及飾演朴老虎的陳善圭時，金泰梨滿意地表示：
n.en:
Now in her sixth year since debut, Kim Tae-ri has built a filmography that, while relatively short, is remarkably substantial. She made a dazzling commercial film debut in director Park Chan-wook's The Handmaiden, followed by 1987: When the Day Comes, which depicts the events surrounding the torture and death of student activist Park Jong-chul, director Yim Soon-rye's Little Forest, and screenwriter Kim Eun-sook's television drama Mr. Sunshine.

Through choices that defy conventional expectations, Kim has naturally brought to life a variety of characters living in different historical periods. She is one of those actresses who reminds audiences just how enjoyable it can be to witness the growth of a rising talent. This time, Kim Tae-ri transforms into the charismatic captain of Space Sweepers, taking viewers into the universe of 2092.

In the film, she plays Captain Jang, who was once the captain of a notorious space-pirate crew before changing her identity and taking command of the space-debris collection ship Victory. One of the film's greatest highlights is the chemistry among its cast. Speaking about Song Joong-ki as Tae-ho, Yoo Hae-jin as Bubs, and Jin Sun-kyu as Tiger Park, Kim expressed her satisfaction:
n.o:
데뷔 6년차, 김태리의 필모그래피는 짧지만 알차다. 박찬욱 감독의 영화 '아가씨'로 화려한 상업영화 데뷔, 박종철 고문치사 사건을 다룬 영화 '1987', 임순례 감독의 영화 '리틀 포레스트', 김은숙 작가의 드라마 '미스터 선샤인'까지. 김태리는 전형성을 벗어난 선택을 통해 다른 시대 속 새로운 인물을 자연스럽게 변주해왔다. 신예의 성장을 지켜보는 일은 얼마나 즐거운지 대중에게 느끼게 하는 배우 중 하나다. 김태리는 이번엔 '승리호'의 카리스마 선장으로 분해 2092년 우주로 시청자를 이끈다.

영화 '승리호'에서 김태리는 한때 악명 높은 우주 해적단의 선장으로 신분을 바꾼 후 우주 쓰레기 청소선 승리호를 이끄는 장 선장 역을 연기했다. '승리호'의 백미는 배우들의 합이었다. 김태리는 태호 역의 송중기, 업동이 역 유해진, 타이거박 역 진선규에 대해 "호흡이 너무 좋았다"며 만족감을 드러냈다.

a.zh: 「我們之間的默契真的非常好。」
a.en: “Our chemistry was incredibly good.”

n.zh: 在最近進行的訪談中，金泰梨分享了與三位演員合作的經歷。她第一次見到陳善圭，是在首爾藝術殿堂舉行的一場演出上。金泰梨回憶道：
n.en: During a recent interview, Kim Tae-ri shared her experiences of working with the three actors. Her first encounter with Jin Sun-kyu took place at a performance held at the Seoul Arts Center. Kim recalled:
n.o: 최근 진행된 인터뷰에서 김태리는 세 명의 배우들과 호흡을 맞춘 소감을 전했다. 진선규와 첫 만남은 예술의 전당에서 진행된 한 공연에서였다. 김태리는 "당시 진선규 배우는 '극한직업' 팀과 공연을 보러 왔더라. 그땐 타이거박(진석규 캐릭터)이 될지 모르고 있었는데, 진선규가 제게 오더니 속삭이며 '저 승리호에요'라고 말했다"며 박장대소했다.

a.zh: 「當時，陳善圭演員是和《雞不可失》的劇組一起來看表演的。那時候，我還不知道他後來會飾演朴老虎這個角色。結果，他突然走到我旁邊，悄悄地對我說：『我也有演《勝利號》喔。』」
a.en: “At the time, Jin Sun-kyu had come to watch the performance with the Extreme Job team. I didn't know yet that he was going to play Tiger Park. Then he suddenly came over to me and whispered: 'I'm in Space Sweepers, too.'”

n.zh: 說到這裡，金泰梨忍不住放聲大笑。
n.en: Kim burst into hearty laughter as she recalled the moment.

n.zh: 雖然只是一次短暫的見面，金泰梨卻表示，自己當時就已經感受到了陳善圭良善的個性。她解釋：
n.en: Although their first meeting was brief, Kim said she could already sense Jin Sun-kyu's good character.
n.o: 짧은 만남이었지만 진선규의 인간성을 느낄 수 있었다고 했다. 김태리는 "처음 만남부터 좋았다. 선한 느낌이 딱 보였다. 진선규가 특이한 점은 연기를 할 때 의심이 많다는 거다. 저도 한 의심 하는데 '의심친구'를 만나게 됐다. 둘이서 '이 정도 연기하면 되나'라며 머리를 맞댔다"고 설명했다.

a.zh:
「從第一次見面開始，我對他的印象就非常好。一眼就能感覺到，他是一個很善良的人。不過，陳善圭有一個很特別的地方，就是他演戲的時候，總是會有很多懷疑。而我自己其實也是個很容易懷疑的人。所以這次等於遇到了一個『懷疑夥伴』。（笑）

我們兩個人會湊在一起，不斷討論：『這樣演真的可以嗎？』『演到這個程度就夠了嗎？』就這樣一起絞盡腦汁、反覆思考。」
a.en: “I liked him from the very first time we met. You could immediately tell that he was a genuinely kind person. One unusual thing about Jin Sun-kyu is that he questions things a lot when he's acting. I'm quite a skeptical person myself. So I felt like I'd finally met a fellow 'doubting partner.' (Laughs.) The two of us would put our heads together and keep asking: 'Is it okay to act like this?' 'Is this level of performance enough?' We'd keep discussing it and thinking things through together.”

n.zh: 談到比自己年長五歲的宋仲基時，金泰梨則稱讚道：
n.en: Speaking about Song Joong-ki, who is five years older than her, Kim praised his maturity.
n.o: 5살 연상의 배우 송중기에 대해 "나이 차이가 얼마 안 나는데 너무 어른"이라며 칭찬했다. 김태리는 "저는 '아가씨' 할 때 주변의 사람들이 구체적으로 기억이 나지 않는다. 인지가 없었던 거다. 점차 나아지면서 주변의 사람들이 보였다. '승리호' 때 그걸 느끼게 됐다"고 했다. 그러면서 "송중기는 이미 그 중심에서 모든 스태프들을 다독이고, 챙기더라. 실제로 선장 역할을 누가 해야하냐고 묻는다면 단연 송중기를 꼽겠다"고 치켜세웠다.

a.zh:
「明明我們的年齡差距沒有很大，但他卻真的非常成熟，很有大人的樣子。其實，我在拍攝《下女的誘惑》的時候，現在已經沒辦法清楚記得當時身邊的那些人了。因為那時候的我，根本沒有真正意識到周圍的人。但隨著時間慢慢過去，我也逐漸有所成長，開始能夠注意到身邊的人。

到了拍攝《勝利號》的時候，我就特別感受到這件事。而宋仲基那時候，早就已經站在大家的中心，照顧著所有工作人員，鼓勵大家、安慰大家。如果真的有人問我，現實生活中誰最適合擔任船長，我一定會毫不猶豫地選宋仲基。」
a.en:
“We aren't that far apart in age, but he's such a grown-up. He's incredibly mature. When I was filming The Handmaiden, I didn't really remember the people around me in much detail. Back then, I simply wasn't very aware of my surroundings or the people in them. But as time passed and I gradually improved, I began to notice the people around me more.

I became especially aware of that during Space Sweepers. And Song Joong-ki was already at the center of everything, reassuring and taking care of all the staff. If someone asked me who should be the captain in real life, I'd choose Song Joong-ki without hesitation.”

n.zh: 至於柳海真，金泰梨則形容：
n.en: As for Yoo Hae-jin, Kim described his performance by saying:
n.o: 유해진에 대해서는 "업동이는 유해진이 하나 하나 조각한 느낌"이라며 "시나리오에서 본 것보다 100배, 200배는 어렵더라. 저는 업동이는 못 할거 같다"고 혀를 내둘렀다.

a.zh: 「我覺得，業童這個角色就像是柳海真前輩一點一滴親手雕刻出來的一樣。實際看到他表演之後，才發現這個角色的難度，比我當初讀劇本時想像的，還要困難一百倍、兩百倍。我想，如果換成是我，應該根本沒辦法演業童。」
a.en: “I feel as though Bubs was a character that Yoo Hae-jin carefully sculpted, piece by piece, with his own hands. After seeing him perform, I realized that the role was a hundred or even two hundred times more difficult than I'd imagined from reading the screenplay. I don't think I could ever play Bubs myself.”

n.zh: 她對柳海真的表演能力感到相當驚嘆。
n.en: She expressed her amazement at his acting abilities.

n.zh: 金泰梨也對在《勝利號》中飾演反派角色的英國演員理查・阿米塔吉（Richard Armitage）讚不絕口。她表示：
n.en: Kim also had high praise for British actor Richard Armitage, who plays the villain in Space Sweepers. She explained:
n.o: '승리호'의 빌런을 연기한 영국 배우 리처드 아미티지에 대해서도 엄지를 치켜세웠다. 그는 "여기는 소통 같은 소통을 할 수 없는 상황인데, 혼자 집중하시는 모습이 너무 멋있더라. 상대 배우를 너무 편하게 해 주셨다. 영어가 주는 톤의 변화가 있는데, 영어권의 연기는 한국어 연기와는 또 다르다는 것을 체감하게 됐다"고 말했다.

a.zh:
「當時的情況是，我們其實沒有辦法真正做到很充分的溝通。但即使在那樣的環境裡，他還是能夠獨自保持專注，那個樣子真的非常帥氣。而且，他也會讓和自己對戲的演員感到非常自在。英文這種語言本身，就會因為語氣和聲調而產生不同的變化。

透過這次合作，我也實際感受到，以英文進行的表演，和以韓文進行的表演，確實有很不一樣的地方。」
a.en: “We were in a situation where we couldn't really communicate with one another properly. But even under those circumstances, he was able to stay completely focused on his own performance. I thought that was incredibly impressive. He also made the actors working opposite him feel very comfortable. English has its own variations in tone and intonation, which can change the way something is expressed. Through this experience, I could really feel that acting in English is different from acting in Korean.”

n.o: 넷플릭스 '승리호'는 황폐해진 지구와 위성 궤도에 만들어진 새로운 보금자리인 UTS, 돈을 벌기 위해 우주선을 개조해 우주 쓰레기를 주우러 다니는 우주해적들의 이야기를 그렸다. 이 영화는 지난해 여름 극장 개봉을 계획했으나 신종 코로나 바이러스 감염증(코로나19) 장기화로 두 번이나 개봉을 연기하다 결국 넷플릭스를 통해 190개국 시청자를 만났다. 공개 2일 만에 해외 28개국에서 1위, 80개국 이상에서 TOP 10순위에 드는 놀라운 기록을 달성했다.
n.zh:
Netflix 電影《勝利號》描繪了因環境破壞而荒廢的地球、在衛星軌道上建立的新居住空間 UTS，以及一群為了賺錢而改裝太空船、四處撿拾宇宙垃圾的太空清理工的故事。這部電影原本預計於前一年夏天在電影院上映，但由於 COVID-19 疫情持續延燒，兩度延期，最後決定透過 Netflix 與全球 190 個國家的觀眾見面。

公開僅兩天，電影便在海外 28 個國家登上排行榜第一名，並進入超過 80 個國家的 TOP 10，創下亮眼的成績。
n.en:
Netflix's Space Sweepers portrays a devastated Earth, UTS, a new residential habitat built in orbit, and a group of space scavengers who modify their spaceship to collect debris in hopes of making money. The film was originally scheduled for a theatrical release the previous summer. However, as the COVID-19 pandemic continued, its release was postponed twice before it ultimately premiered on Netflix, reaching audiences in 190 countries.

Within just two days of its release, the film ranked No. 1 in 28 countries overseas and entered the Top 10 in more than 80 countries, achieving remarkable results.

n.zh: 從朴贊郁導演到金銀淑編劇，金泰梨無論在電影或電視劇領域，都曾與許多重量級創作者合作。不知不覺間，她的名字似乎也成為了一種新的成功公式。不少人稱讚她挑選作品的眼光，認為她總能找到具有潛力的好作品。對此，金泰梨表示：
n.en: From director Park Chan-wook to screenwriter Kim Eun-sook, Kim Tae-ri has worked with many of the industry's most respected creators across both film and television. Over time, her name has seemingly become associated with successful productions. Many have praised her judgment in choosing projects, noting her ability to recognize promising works. In response, Kim Tae-ri said:
n.o: 김태리는 박찬욱 감독부터 김은숙 작가까지 브라운관, 스크린을 가리지 않고 많은 거장들과 작업해왔다. 어느새 새로운 흥행공식이 됐다. 작품을 고르는 그의 선구안에 칭찬을 쏟아내는 이들도 많다. 그는 "그저 감사할 뿐"이라며 "감독님들 사시는 동안 많은 작품 해주셨으면 좋겠다. 외국 작품 말고 한국 작품해주셨으면 좋겠다. 제게 온 복이라고 생각한다"고 말했다.

a.zh: 「我真的就只是覺得很感謝而已。我希望那些導演們，在往後的人生裡，還能繼續創作很多很多作品。而且希望他們不要都跑去拍外國電影，要繼續拍韓國電影。我覺得，能夠遇到這些導演，真的是降臨在我身上的福氣。」
a.en: “I'm simply grateful. I hope these directors continue making lots and lots of films throughout their lives. And I hope they keep making Korean films rather than moving on to foreign productions. I consider it a blessing that I've had the chance to work with them.”

n.zh: 金泰梨也坦言，這次參與《勝利號》時，確實感受到了不小的壓力。
n.en: Kim Tae-ri also admitted that she felt considerable pressure while working on Space Sweepers.
n.o: 김태리는 "'아가씨'도 큰 작품이었고 '미스터 선샤인'도 그랬다. 그 중에서도 '승리호'가 정말 컸다. 그런 데 있어서 부담이 조금은 있었다"고 털어놨다. 그는 "부담감을 어떤 식으로 희석했냐면, '우리 영화는 중기 오빠가 주인공'이라며 농담하며 부담감을 내려놨다. 부담이란 어쩔 수 없이 가지게 되는 부분이 있지만 연기 하는데 원동력이 되지 않는다고 생각한다. 그런 부담감은 재빨리 털어버리는 게 낫다는 것이 '승리호' 촬영하며 배운 점"이라고 귀띔했다. 아울러 "그런 것보다 이 인물을 어떻게 살아 숨쉬게 할지를 고민하는 게 낫다는 깨닳음을 얻었다"고 덧붙였다.

a.zh: 「《下女的誘惑》是一部規模很大的作品，《陽光先生》也是。但在這些作品之中，《勝利號》的規模又特別龐大。所以在這方面，我確實感受到了一些負擔。」
a.en: “The Handmaiden was a major production, and so was Mr. Sunshine. But even among those projects, Space Sweepers was particularly large in scale. So in that respect, I did feel some pressure.”

n.zh: 至於自己如何消化這份壓力，她笑著分享：
n.en: Explaining how she managed to ease that burden, she said:

a.zh:
「如果要說我是怎麼減輕那種壓力的……我就會開玩笑地說：『反正我們這部電影的主角是仲基歐巴嘛！』然後，就這樣把壓力放下了。（笑）當然，身為演員，有些壓力是無可避免的。可是我覺得，那些壓力其實並不會成為推動表演的動力。所以，最好還是盡快把那種負擔感甩開。

這是我在拍攝《勝利號》的過程中學到的事情。而且，我也因此領悟到，與其一直在意那些壓力，不如好好思考：『我究竟要怎麼做，才能讓眼前這個角色真正活起來，像是會呼吸的人一樣？』這才是更值得花時間去煩惱的事情。」
a.en:
“As for how I dealt with the pressure… I'd joke around and say: 'Well, Joong-ki oppa is the main character of our movie anyway!' And that helped me let go of the burden. (Laughs.) Of course, some pressure is unavoidable when you're an actor. But I don't think that kind of pressure actually motivates you to perform better. So it's better to shake it off as quickly as possible.

That's one of the things I learned while filming Space Sweepers. I also came to realize that, rather than worrying about those pressures, it would be better to focus on one question: 'How can I make this character truly come alive, as though they're a real, breathing person?' That's something much more worthwhile to think about.”

n.zh: 談到與趙成熙導演的合作時，金泰梨表示：
n.en: Speaking about her collaboration with director Jo Sung-hee, Kim Tae-ri explained:
n.o: 조성희 감독과의 작업에 대해 "'승리호'라는 영화 안에서 어떤 부분을 부각시켜 보여주고 싶은지 그런 선택으로 만들어진 것 같다. 장 선장 등 캐릭터마다 사연은 적어 아쉽기도 하지만 전체의 흐름, 완결성, 감독의 색을 내기 위한 선택이라고 생각한다"고 했다.

a.zh: 「我覺得，整部《勝利號》最後呈現出來的樣子，是導演不斷思考，究竟想在電影裡特別凸顯哪些部分，並據此做出取捨的結果。雖然包括張船長在內，每個角色各自的背景故事都比較少，這一點確實讓人有些可惜。但我認為，那是為了整部電影的敘事節奏、故事的完整性，以及呈現導演自己的風格，而做出的選擇。」
a.en: “I think the final version of Space Sweepers was shaped by the director's decisions about which aspects of the story he wanted to emphasize. It's a little disappointing that there isn't more background information about each character, including Captain Jang. But I believe those choices were made to preserve the overall flow and completeness of the film, while also bringing out the director's distinctive style.”

n.zh: 金泰梨也讚嘆，《勝利號》是一部遠遠超出自己想像的作品。她表示：
n.en: Kim Tae-ri also praised Space Sweepers for surpassing her own imagination.
n.o: 김태리는 '승리호'가 자신의 상상력을 뛰어 넘은 작품이라고 칭찬했다. "제가 시나리오를 보며 상상했던 것 그 이상이더라. 그래서 감독을 못하고 배우를 하는 것 같다. 영화에서 나온대로 현장에서 상상하며 연기했으면 너무 좋았겠다 싶을 정도로 멋진 장면들이 많더라"라고 말했다.

a.zh: 「最後呈現出來的畫面，真的超越了我當初讀劇本時所能想像的一切。所以我才會覺得，自己果然當不了導演，只能當演員吧。（笑）因為電影裡真的有太多非常精彩的場景了。精彩到讓我忍不住想：『如果當初在拍攝現場，我就能像電影最後呈現出來的那樣去想像，然後進行表演，那該有多好啊。』」
a.en: “The finished film went far beyond anything I'd imagined while reading the screenplay. I guess that's why I'm an actress rather than a director. (Laughs.) There were so many incredible scenes in the film. They were so impressive that I couldn't help thinking: 'If only I'd been able to imagine those scenes on set exactly as they appeared in the finished film, it would have been wonderful to perform with those images in mind.'”

n.zh: 繼《勝利號》之後，金泰梨目前也正在拍攝崔東勳導演執導的科幻電影《外星+人》。她開心地表示：
n.en: Following Space Sweepers, Kim Tae-ri is currently filming director Choi Dong-hoon's science-fiction film Alienoid. She expressed her happiness, saying:
n.o: 김태리는 '승리호'에 이어 최동훈 감독의 SF '외계인'을 촬영 중이다. 그는 "새로운 장르가 만들어지고 있는 시점에 SF에 출연하는 것에 대해 감개무량하고 행복하다"며 기쁨을 드러냈다. 김예랑 한경닷컴 기자 yesrang@hankyung.com

a.zh: 「在韓國電影界正逐漸發展、創造出新類型作品的這個時刻，能夠參與科幻電影的演出，真的讓我感慨萬千，也覺得非常幸福。」
a.en: “At a time when a new genre is beginning to take shape in the Korean film industry, being able to participate in science-fiction films makes me deeply moved and incredibly happy.”

n.zh: Hankyung.com／記者：金藝朗 yesrang@hankyung.com
n.en: Hankyung.com / Reporter: Kim Ye-rang yesrang@hankyung.com

items.title: 金泰梨：「我覺得，愛自己是最重要的事。」（Kuki News）

en.title: Kim Tae-ri: "I Think Loving Yourself Is the Most Important Thing" (Kuki News)

a.zh: 「《勝利號》嗎？是我的第四部長篇電影啊。」
a.en: “Space Sweepers? That's my fourth feature film.”
a.o: “'승리호'요? 제 네 번째 장편영화죠.” 특유의 호탕한 웃음소리가 이어폰을 타고 들려왔다. 영화 '아가씨'(감독 박찬욱)를 자신의 첫 번째 장편영화, 영화 '1987'(감독 장준환)을 두 번째 장편영화라고 설명하는 배우 김태리식 화법이다. 지난 5일 넷플릭스에서 공개된 영화 '승리호'는 어김없이 김태리의 '네 번째 장편영화'로 호명됐다.

n.zh: 耳機另一端，傳來了金泰梨那獨特而爽朗的笑聲。這就是演員金泰梨特有的說話方式。對她而言，朴贊郁導演的《下女的誘惑》是自己的第一部長篇電影，張駿桓導演的《1987》則是第二部。而在 2 月 5 日透過 Netflix 上線的《勝利號》，自然也被她稱為自己的「第四部長篇電影」。
n.en: Her distinctive, hearty laughter came through the earphones. It was a characteristically Kim Tae-ri way of describing her career. She refers to director Park Chan-wook's The Handmaiden as her first feature film and director Jang Joon-hwan's 1987 as her second. Naturally, Space Sweepers, which was released on Netflix on February 5, was introduced as her “fourth feature film.”

n.o: 최근 화상 인터뷰로 만난 김태리는 자신이 '승리호'에서 연기한 장선장을 처음 시나리오로 봤을 당시 이야기를 꺼냈다. 장선장이 자신의 얼굴로 그려지지 않는다는 그에게 조성희 감독은 '선장'의 전형성을 벗어나고 싶다는 이야기를 했다. 모두를 통솔하는 카리스마를 보여주는 선장 대신, 김태리 만의 다른 선장을 보여줄 수 있을 것 같다는 감독을 믿고 출연을 결정했다.
n.zh:
在最近進行的視訊訪談中，金泰梨談起了自己第一次從《勝利號》的劇本中接觸張船長這個角色時的經歷。當時，她告訴趙成熙導演，自己實在無法想像張船長會有著和自己一樣的臉。導演則向她解釋，他希望能夠跳脫人們對「船長」這個角色的刻板印象。

比起塑造一位充滿威嚴、以強大氣場統率所有人的船長，導演認為，金泰梨或許能夠呈現出一種只有她才能詮釋的、截然不同的船長形象。最終，金泰梨選擇相信導演的想法，決定參與演出。
n.en:
During a recent video interview, Kim Tae-ri recalled her first impressions of Captain Jang when she read the screenplay for Space Sweepers. She had told director Jo Sung-hee that she simply couldn't picture Captain Jang with her own face. The director explained that he wanted to move away from the conventional image of a captain.

Rather than portraying a commanding, charismatic leader who controls everyone around her, he believed Kim could bring something different to the role — a version of Captain Jang that only she could portray. Trusting the director's vision, Kim ultimately decided to join the film.

a.zh:
「真正開始嘗試詮釋張船長之後，我才發現，她其實是一個比我原本想像中複雜得多的人物。因為一直在思考，究竟該怎麼呈現她那麼複雜的一面，所以最後演出來的張船長，反而變得比較沉穩、有分量。我認為，張船長是一個擁有自己信念、不會輕易受到外界影響的人。

我覺得，她之所以能夠成為船長，就是因為她是一個看得見整片森林，而不只是眼前某一棵樹的人。其實，張船長是個不折不扣的菁英。所以我想了很多，究竟該怎麼樣，才能好好呈現她身為一個普通人的樣子——一個和其他船員在如同家庭般的太空船裡，共同生活、一起呼吸的人。

可是，後來真正看到完成的電影時，我又有點遺憾。我甚至會想，如果當初讓張船長再放肆一點、再不按常理行事一點，會不會更好呢？雖然那樣可能會變得有點像漫畫人物一樣誇張，但我還是覺得，如果能夠展現出她更有活力、更生動的一面，或許會更好。」
a.en:
“Once I actually started working on Captain Jang, I realized she was a much more complicated character than I'd initially imagined. I spent a lot of time thinking about how to portray that complexity, and as a result, my interpretation of her ended up being somewhat more serious and grounded. I saw Captain Jang as someone with her own convictions, someone who isn't easily swayed by others.

I thought she was able to be the captain precisely because she's someone who sees the forest rather than just the individual trees. In fact, Captain Jang is an absolute elite. So I thought a great deal about how to portray her as a human being, someone who lives and works alongside the others aboard a spaceship that feels almost like a family.

But when I finally watched the finished movie, I also had some regrets. I found myself wondering what it would have been like if Captain Jang had been a little more reckless or unruly. It might have made her portrayal somewhat cartoonish, but I still thought it would have been nice to show a more energetic and lively side of her.”
a.o: “장 선장을 연기하려고 겪어보니까 생각했던 것보다 훨씬 복잡한 인물이더라고요. 그 복잡한 인물을 어떻게 보여줄 수 있을까 고민하다보니까 조금 묵직한 인물로 나왔어요. 전 장 선장이 자기 신념이 있고 쉽게 휘둘리지 않는 인물이라고 생각했어요. 나무가 아닌 숲을 보는 사람이기 때문에 선장으로 있는 것 같았거든요. 사실 장선장은 완전 엘리트예요. 가족 같은 선내에서 함께 호흡하며 살아가는 한 인간을 어떻게 하면 잘 보여줄 수 있을까 고민을 많이 했어요. 막상 영화를 보면서 장 선장이 더 막나갔으면 어땠을까 하는 아쉬움도 들었어요. 만화 같은 표현이 될 수도 있겠지만 활기찬 모습을 보여줬으면 좋았겠다는 생각을 했습니다.”

n.o: 영화 '승리호' 스틸컷 '승리호'는 공개 당시부터 완성도 높은 CG로 화제를 모았다. 이제 한국에서도 이렇게 실감나는 우주 영화를 찍을 수 있다는 희망을 줬다. 김태리는 세트와 크로마키 촬영을 병행하며 찍었다고 했다. 그에게도, 모두에게도 첫 도전이었기에 함께 만들어갈 수 있었다.
n.zh:
《勝利號》電影劇照《勝利號》自公開以來，便憑藉完成度極高的電腦特效引發話題。這部電影也帶來了一份希望：如今，即使在韓國，也能夠製作出如此逼真的太空電影。金泰梨表示，拍攝過程同時使用了實體布景與色鍵去背技術（Chroma Key）。

因為無論對她自己，還是對所有參與製作的人而言，這都是第一次嘗試，所以大家才能在不斷摸索的過程中，一起完成這部作品。
n.en:
Still from Space Sweepers Since its release, Space Sweepers has attracted attention for its high-quality computer-generated effects. The film also offered a sense of possibility, showing that realistic space movies of this kind could now be produced in Korea. Kim Tae-ri explained that filming combined physical sets with chroma-key technology.

Because it was a first-time challenge not only for her but for everyone involved, they were able to work through the unfamiliar process together and gradually bring the film to life.

a.zh:
「我們四名船員經常活動的太空船內部，全部都是實際搭建出來的布景。那些按鈕真的可以按，就像設備實際能夠運作一樣，很多細節也都做得非常完整。因此，對我的表演幫助很大。不過，我們也有使用色鍵去背技術拍攝的部分。像是必須朝著根本看不見的敵人開槍，那樣的場景就真的有些困難。

可是，這不只是我第一次嘗試的演出方式，對大家來說也都是第一次挑戰。所以想到這一點，我反而覺得有些安慰。大家就這樣互相打氣、鼓勵彼此，一起努力完成拍攝。我們就是厚著臉皮，裝得好像真的看得見那些東西一樣去演。」
a.en:
“The entire interior of the spaceship, where the four crew members spend most of their time, was built as a physical set. The buttons could actually be pressed as though everything really worked, and so many details were properly constructed. That helped my performance a great deal. But there were also scenes filmed using chroma-key technology.

For example, we had to fire guns at enemies we couldn't actually see, and those scenes were difficult. Still, it wasn't just my first time attempting something like that. It was a new experience and a challenge for everyone. Knowing that was actually comforting. We encouraged one another and worked together to make it happen. We just had to be shameless about it and act as though everything was really there.”
a.o: “네 명의 선원들이 활동을 많이 하는 선내는 전부 세트로 지어졌어요. 실제로 작동하는 것처럼 버튼도 눌리고 많은 게 제대로 되어있는 곳이어서 도움을 많이 받았죠. 하지만 크로마키 촬영이 있었어요. 안 보이는 적을 향해 총을 쏴야했고 그런 장면들은 어려운 부분들이 있었어요. 하지만 저뿐 아니라 다들 처음 하는 연기고 도전이었기 때문에 위안을 느끼면서 으쌰으쌰 만들어갔습니다. 뻔뻔하게 했죠.”

a.zh:
「電影一開始，有一個場景是我說：『閃開，你們這群沒用的傢伙！那是我的！』那場戲裡，我其實只是在太空船內說出台詞而已。因為整個場景幾乎都是用 CG 製作出來的。所以連我自己，也是直到看了完成的電影，才第一次真正看到那個畫面。

我真的覺得太棒了。比我原本想像的還要好上太多太多。看著那個場景，我真的非常感動。我突然覺得，現在即使是在韓國，也真的沒有什麼故事是不能講、不能拍出來的了。」
a.en:
“There's a scene near the beginning of the movie where I say: 'Move aside, you incompetent fools! That one's mine!' For that scene, all I actually did was deliver my lines inside the spaceship. Almost everything else was created using CG. So even I didn't get to see what the scene really looked like until I watched the finished film.

I thought it was absolutely wonderful. It was far better than anything I'd imagined. Watching that scene was genuinely moving. It made me realize that there really aren't any stories we can't tell or bring to life in Korea anymore.”
a.o: “영화 초반에 제가 '비켜라, 무능한 것들아. 저건 내 거다'라고 말하는 장면이 있어요. 그 장면은 선내에서 대사만 뱉었지 거의 CG로 이뤄진 장면이었죠. 저도 영화로 처음 본 거예요. 너무 좋더라고요. 생각했던 것 이상으로 훨씬 좋았어요. 이제 (한국에서도) 진짜 못할 이야기가 없겠다, 만들 수 없는 이야기가 없겠다는 감동을 느꼈어요.”

n.zh: 在整場採訪中，金泰梨始終以自信而坦率的態度回答問題。然而，當被問到最想向張船長學習哪一點時，她卻選擇了「自信、堂堂正正的態度」。金泰梨自己也知道，這樣的回答可能會讓人感到意外。她說：
n.en: Throughout the interview, Kim Tae-ri spoke with a confident and candid attitude. Yet when asked which quality of Captain Jang she most wanted to have herself, she chose “confidence.” Aware that her answer might seem surprising, she said:
n.o: 누구보다 당당하게 인터뷰를 이어가던 김태리는 장선장에게 닮고 싶은 점으로 '당당함'을 꼽았다. 스스로도 “무슨 소리야? 하실 것 같긴 하지만”이라며 “겉으로는 당당하지만, 오늘 인터뷰한 것도 집에 가서 '아이고, 이런 얘기를 왜 해갖고' 하면서 입을 치고 있을 텐데”라며 특유의 솔직한 입담으로 말을 이어갔다. 그는 배우로서의 단점으로 “멘탈이 약하다”라고 말하지만, '승리호'를 찍으며 많이 달라졌다고 했다.

a.zh: 「我知道大家可能會想：『妳到底在說什麼啊？』雖然我外表看起來很有自信、很堂堂正正的……但其實，就連今天這場訪談，等我回到家之後，可能也會一邊拍打自己的嘴巴，一邊後悔地說：『哎唷，我幹嘛要講那些話啦！』」
a.en: “I know people might be thinking: 'What are you talking about?' I may look confident and self-assured on the outside… But even after today's interview, I'll probably go home, smack myself on the mouth, and say: 'Oh no, why did I say all those things?'”

n.zh: 她以自己一貫率直而幽默的方式繼續分享想法。雖然金泰梨認為自己身為演員的一項缺點，是「心理不夠堅強」，但她也表示，經過《勝利號》的拍攝之後，自己已經改變了許多。
n.en: She continued speaking with her characteristic honesty and humor. Although Kim described one of her weaknesses as an actress as being “mentally fragile,” she said that she had changed considerably while working on Space Sweepers.

a.zh:
「拍攝《勝利號》的時候，我一直處在很大的壓力與緊張之中。拍完整部電影之後，我開始經常提醒自己：『要好好看看身邊的人。』『要多想想那些愛著自己的人。』當我開始用這樣的眼光去看待周圍的一切時，才發現，原來真的有那麼多人愛著我、支持著我、珍惜著我。

而那些人對我說的每一句話，我都能夠真真切切地感受到。那種感覺，就像是連指尖都能接收到他們的心意一樣。該怎麼說呢……我覺得自己在拍攝現場，內心變得更加富足了。也因為這樣，我好像逐漸擺脫了原本那些壓力和緊張。心情比以前輕鬆、自在了許多。

但我不覺得這是因為自己成長了多少，才終於達到這樣的狀態。我反而覺得，只是現在的我，剛好正處在一段如此豐盛、充滿溫暖與關愛的時期。誰知道以後還會不會再有這樣的時候呢？」
a.en:
“I filmed Space Sweepers while dealing with a tremendous amount of pressure and anxiety. After we finished filming, I started reminding myself of two things: 'Pay more attention to the people around you.' 'Think about the people who love you.' Once I began looking at things that way, I realized how many people genuinely love, support, and care about me.

And I could truly feel every word those people said to me. It was almost as though their feelings were reaching all the way to my fingertips. How should I put it… I think my heart became richer and fuller while I was on set. And because of that, I was able to free myself from much of the pressure and tension I'd been feeling. I became much more comfortable and at ease than before.

But I don't think it happened because I'd suddenly grown or matured so much. Rather, I think I'm simply going through a particularly abundant and fulfilling period in my life right now, surrounded by so much warmth and affection. Who knows when I'll experience another time like this?”
a.o: “'승리호'를 큰 부담감과 긴장 속에서 찍었어요. 영화를 다 찍고 나서 '주변을 잘 돌아보자', '나를 사랑해주는 사람들을 생각하자'는 생각을 많이 했어요. 그렇게 눈을 뜨니까 정말 나를 사랑해주고 응원해주고 아껴주시는 분들이 하시는 말씀들이 손끝으로 다 전달되더라고요. 현장에서 마음이 풍요로워졌다고 할까요. 부담감이나 긴장에서 많이 벗어날 수 있었던 것 같아요. 마음이 예전보다 편해졌어요. 제가 성장해서 이뤄진 게 아니라, 지금이 그런 풍요로운 때인 것 같아요. 언제 또 이런 시기가 올지 모르죠.”

n.zh: 在這次訪談中，金泰梨談了很多關於「人」的事情。無論是對一起拍攝的夥伴所抱持的信任、在人際關係中經歷的煩惱，還是那些善良的人對自己所帶來的影響，都自然而然地流露在她的話語之中。她甚至露出燦爛的笑容說：
n.en: Throughout the interview, Kim Tae-ri spoke frequently about people. Her words naturally reflected the trust she placed in her fellow cast members, her concerns about human relationships, and the influence that kind people had on her life. At one point, she smiled brightly and said:
n.o: 김태리는 인터뷰에서 사람에 대한 이야기를 많이 했다. 함께 촬영하는 동료에 대한 믿음과 인간관계에 대한 고민, 좋은 사람들에 대한 영향력이 그의 말 속에 스며있었다. 환하게 웃으며 “인복이 매우 좋습니다. 복이 터졌어요. 좋은 사람을 만나서 별다른 노력을 하지 않아도 좋은 환경에서 연기할 수 있었던 것 같아요”라고 말할 정도다. 장선장이 강한 신념을 갖고 있듯, 배우 김태리가 갖고 있는 신념이 무엇인지도 들려줬다.

a.zh: 「我的人緣和遇到好人的運氣真的非常好。簡直是好運多到快要滿出來了！因為遇到了很多很好的人，所以即使沒有特別費力地做些什麼，也能夠在很好的環境裡安心演戲。」
a.en: “I've been incredibly lucky when it comes to the people in my life. I've been blessed beyond belief! I've met such wonderful people that, without having to make any extraordinary effort, I've been able to act in a really good environment.”

n.zh: 就如同電影裡的張船長擁有堅定的信念，訪談最後，金泰梨也分享了自己身為演員、同時身為一個人，所抱持的信念。
n.en: Just as Captain Jang possesses strong convictions, Kim Tae-ri also shared the beliefs she holds both as an actress and as an individual.

a.zh: 「我覺得，愛自己是最重要的事情。我希望自己能夠好好愛著身邊的人。而且，我也希望自己能夠成為一個，即使面對不認識的人，也願意將愛分享出去的人。無論是作為演員金泰梨，還是作為一個普通人金泰梨，我都是這樣想的。」
a.en: “I think loving yourself is the most important thing. I want to love the people around me. And I want to become someone who can share love even with people I don't know. That's how I feel both as Kim Tae-ri the actress and as Kim Tae-ri the person.”
a.o: “나 자신을 사랑하는 게 가장 중요한 것 같아요. 내 주변 사람을 사랑했으면 좋겠고, 내가 모르는 사람에게도 사랑을 나눠줄 수 있는 그런 인간이고 싶습니다. 배우 김태리로서도, 사람 김태리로서도 그래요.”

n.o: bluebell@kukinews.com
n.zh: 記者：李俊範 bluebell@kukinews.com
n.en: Reporter: Lee Jun-beom bluebell@kukinews.com

items.title: 金泰梨：「多虧了宋仲基，我才擁有了更開闊的視野。」（Digital Chosun）

en.title: Kim Tae-ri: "Thanks to Song Joong-ki, I've Gained a Broader Perspective" (Digital Chosun)

n.o: 제공 배우 김태리의 필모그래피를 한 단어로 요약해보면 '도전'이라는 단어가 떠오를 것 같다. 1500:1의 경쟁률을 뚷고 영화 '아가씨'의 숙희 역을 맡은 것으로 시작해 최근에는 한국 최초의 SF영화 '승리호' 속 장선장 모습을 보여줬다. 장엄한 표정과 굳은 결의에 찬 발걸음을 내디딜 것 같지만, 사실 김태리는 그런 이미지와는 다르다. 화상으로 진행된 인터뷰를 마치고 함께 진행한 기자들에게 모두 "우리 오래오래 일해요"라고 감사 인사를 전하는 배우, 보고 있으면 미소를 짓게 되는, 그러면서도 속에 무언가 가득 차있는듯한, 그런 배우가 바로 김태리다.
n.zh:
如果要用一個詞來概括演員金泰梨至今的作品履歷，或許最先浮現的，就是「挑戰」。從最初在 1,500 人的競爭中脫穎而出，獲得電影《下女的誘惑》中淑姬一角，到最近在韓國首部大型太空科幻電影《勝利號》中，展現張船長的全新面貌，金泰梨似乎始終走在不斷挑戰自己的道路上。

或許人們會想像，她是一個總是神情莊嚴、帶著堅定決心向前邁進的人。但事實上，金泰梨與那樣的形象有些不同。在視訊訪談結束之後，她會向所有參與訪談的記者表達感謝，並對大家說：「我們要一起工作很久很久喔。」她是一位光是看著，就會讓人不自覺露出微笑的演員。

然而，在那份親切與自然之中，又彷彿能夠感受到，她的內心深處裝著許多豐富而充實的東西。這樣的演員，就是金泰梨。
n.en:
If Kim Tae-ri's filmography could be summed up in a single word, that word would probably be “challenge.” From winning the role of Sook-hee in The Handmaiden against 1,500 other candidates to recently portraying Captain Jang in Korea's first major space science-fiction film, Space Sweepers, her career has been marked by a willingness to take on new challenges.

One might imagine her as someone who always wears a solemn expression and moves forward with firm determination. But in reality, Kim Tae-ri is rather different from that image. After finishing the video interview, she thanked all the participating reporters and told them: “Let's keep working together for a long, long time.” She's the kind of actress who makes people smile simply by watching her.

At the same time, beneath that warm and approachable presence, there seems to be something rich and substantial within her. That is Kim Tae-ri.

n.zh: 談到《勝利號》中的張船長，金泰梨表示：
n.en: Speaking about Captain Jang in Space Sweepers, Kim Tae-ri explained:
n.o: '승리호'의 장선장에 대해 김태리는 "'승리호'가 권총이라면, 장선장은 방아쇠라는 마음으로 임했습니다"라고 전했다. 그린 매트에서 상상력을 더해 연기해야 했고, 볼드한 선글라스를 쓰고 마치 홍콩영화 속 주윤발 같은 모습으로 등장해 선원들을 이끄는 모습을 보여줘야 했다. 김태리에 대해 조성희 감독은 "큰 사람"이란 인상을 받았다.

a.zh: 「如果說《勝利號》是一把手槍，那我就是抱著『張船長是扳機』的想法去演出的。」
a.en: “I approached the role with the idea that if Space Sweepers were a gun, Captain Jang would be the trigger.”

n.zh: 拍攝時，她必須站在綠幕前，運用自己的想像力進行表演。她還得戴上造型大膽的墨鏡，以近似香港電影中周潤發的形象登場，展現出率領船員們的船長氣勢。而趙成熙導演對金泰梨的印象，則是「一個很有氣度、格局很大的人」。
n.en: During filming, she had to perform in front of green screens, relying heavily on her imagination. She also had to appear wearing bold sunglasses, resembling Chow Yun-fat in a Hong Kong action film, while convincingly portraying someone who leads an entire crew. Director Jo Sung-hee, meanwhile, described his impression of Kim Tae-ri as “a person of great stature and presence.”

a.zh: 「我覺得，所謂『很有氣度、格局很大的人』，大概就是趙成熙導演希望在張船長身上看到的樣子。雖然外表看起來不像那種人，實際上卻是一個非常強悍的人物。所以，我花了很多時間去尋找，在太空船那樣的環境裡，究竟該如何透過一些細微的動作，讓她展現出真正符合『船長』這個稱號的模樣。我思考了很多劇本裡沒有直接寫出來的部分。」
a.en:
“I think that idea of being a 'person of great stature' was what director Jo Sung-hee wanted to see in Captain Jang. Someone who doesn't necessarily look strong but is actually an incredibly powerful person. So I spent a lot of time searching for ways to convey that sense of authority through even the smallest gestures inside the spaceship.

I wanted to show that she truly deserved the title of captain. I thought a great deal about the things that weren't explicitly written in the screenplay.”
a.o: “큰사람이라는 것이 조성희 감독님께서 장선장에게 보고 싶었던 모습인 것 같아요. 얼굴은 그렇게 안 생겼는데 되게 센 사람. 저는 선장이라는 타이틀에 걸맞는 모습을 선내에서 어떤 작은 몸짓으로 보여줄 수 있을까를 많이 찾았어요. 시나리오에는 써있지 않은 부분들을 고민했죠.”

n.zh: 金泰梨曾經在過去的訪談中提到，準備角色時，她會打開自己的「寶物箱」，從中尋找可以運用的東西。那麼，這一次她又是如何逐漸摸索出張船長的模樣呢？金泰梨回答：
n.en: In a previous interview, Kim Tae-ri once said that when preparing for a character, she would open her own “treasure chest” and search through it for something useful. So how did she approach Captain Jang this time?
n.o: 과거 인터뷰에서 김태리는 캐릭터를 준비할 때 자신의 보물상자를 열어 찾아본다고 했다. 장선장의 모습은 어떻게 풀어냈을까.

a.zh: 「我想，這次主要是在拍攝現場，一邊穿上角色的衣服，一邊慢慢找出感覺的。在現場和其他演員見面、聊天。試著坐在張船長平常會使用的空間裡，摸摸她會接觸的那些物品。就是透過這些事情，一點一點地適應這個角色。」
a.en: “I think I mostly figured her out on set, after putting on the character's clothes. I'd meet the other actors and talk with them. I'd sit in the spaces Captain Jang would normally use and touch the objects she'd handle. It was through those experiences that I gradually became accustomed to the character.”
a.o: “일단 그 인물의 옷을 입고 현장에서 풀었던 것 같아요. 현장에서 배우들 만나고, 이야기하고, 장선장이 사용하는 공간에 앉아보고, 사용하는 물건들을 만지면서 적응해나간 것 같아요.”

a.zh:
「其實，我在內心經歷了很多次掙扎。因為我的腦海裡，也存在著某些對人物的刻板印象。像是：『如果是一個船長，究竟應該怎麼做？』我花了很多時間去思考，該如何擺脫那些單一、片面的既定形象。而這些問題，我想也是在和柳海真、陳善圭、宋仲基前輩們不斷交流的過程中，慢慢找到答案的。

後來，我開始不再只是把注意力放在張船長這個人物本身。而是更多地思考，她應該如何和周圍的人互動、配合，彼此之間又有著什麼樣的默契。這麼做之後，許多原本糾結的地方，反而就自然而然地解開了。」
a.en:
“I struggled with myself a lot. Because I have certain stereotypical images of characters in my own mind, too. For example: 'How is a captain supposed to behave?' I spent a lot of time trying to move beyond those narrow, conventional ideas. I think I gradually found the answers through conversations with Yoo Hae-jin, Jin Sun-kyu, and Song Joong-ki.

Eventually, instead of concentrating solely on Captain Jang as an individual, I began thinking more about how she would interact with the people around her and how their relationships and chemistry would work. Once I approached it that way, many of those difficulties seemed to resolve themselves naturally.”
a.o: “제 안에서 많이 싸웠어요. 제 안에도 클리쉐적인 인물상이 있잖아요. 선장이라면 어떻게 해야할까. 그런 단편적인 이미지에서 탈피하는데 고민을 많이 했어요. 그건 유해진, 진선규, 송중기 선배님들과 이야기를 하면서 해결했던 것 같아요. 선장 개인에 집중하기보다, 주변 인물과 호흡을 고민하다보니 자연스럽게 풀어진 것 같아요.”

n.o: '승리호' 현장은 영화 속 처럼 따뜻했다. 차가운 우주였고, 첫 SF 영화를 만들면서 모든 것이 도전이었지만 '함께 만든다'는 마음이 있었다. "선장같은 역할은 (유)해진 선배님이 가장 든든하게 해주셨어요. 또 놀란 부분이 (송)중기 오빠가 현장에서 (조성희) 감독님과 두 번째 호흡이기도 하고, 더 편안하게 사람들을 응원하고 다독이며 '으샤으샤'하는 역할을 잘 하시더라고요. 깜짝 놀랐어요. 이것이 주연배우다라는 느낌이랄까.(웃음)"
n.zh: 《勝利號》的拍攝現場，就像電影裡所描繪的人際關係一樣，充滿了溫暖。雖然故事發生在冰冷的宇宙，而且這是韓國首次嘗試大型太空科幻電影，幾乎所有事情都是全新的挑戰，但大家始終抱持著「一起完成這部電影」的心情。金泰梨表示：
